signals.description: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue pyytää järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö/markkinakartoitus, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa mahdollisia palveluntoimittajia asiakaspalautejärjestelmän toimittajaksi. Markkinakartoituksen avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia ratkaisuista. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyistä Toimittajan on erikseen mainittava toimittamassaan esitteessä sekä annettava arvio mahdollisesta toteutuksen ajankohdasta. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue toivoo esityksiä seuraavista ratkaisuista: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien sote-, pela-palveluiden palautteiden keräämiseen ja hallintaan. - Puhelinpalvelu - Palvelupisteessä asiointi - Sähköinen asiointi Järjestelmän tulee myös mahdollistaa kansallisen asiakaspalautteen keruu Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitoksen (THL) määrittelyjen mukaisesti. Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat: - Hyvinvointialueen työntekijät (johtajat, esihenkilöt) Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet Asianhallinta - Palautetiedon käsittely - Vastaaminen palautteeseen järjestelmän kautta Tekstiviestipalaute - Kahdensuuntainen tekstiviesti - Selainpohjainen tekstiviestikysely - Kyselyn lähetyksen esto henkilöille, jotka ovat kieltäneet viestin lähettämisen Verkkopalaute - Selainpohjainen kysely Koosteet/raportit - Automatisoidut koosteet luvitetuille henkilöille Palautelaitteet - fyysiset palaute laitteet Tekoäly - Palautedatan analysointi, nostojen ja trendien muodostaminen - Interaktiivinen palaute Integraatiot - Tietojen vienti ja raportointi (Tietoallas) - Käyttäjätunnusten hallinnointi Entra ID:n kautta (hyvinvointialueen työntekijät, jotka käsittelevät palautteita) - Mahdolliset integraatiot potilas- ja asiakastietotietojärjestelmä Tekniset vaatimukset - Pilvipohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - Suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä - Saavutettavuusdirektiivin mukainen toteutus - Jatkuva ylläpito ja päivitykset - Käyttötuki suomeksi Pyydämme teitä vastaamaan seuraaviin kysymyksiin: Ratkaisun yleiskuvaus - Onko teillä tarjolla yllä kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältävä järjestelmäratkaisu? - Mikä on ratkaisunne nimi ja lyhyt kuvaus? - Mitkä ovat ratkaisunne keskeiset vahvuudet? Toiminnallisuudet - Miten ratkaisunne täyttää kuvatut toiminnallisuudet? Tekniset ominaisuudet - Millainen on ratkaisun tekninen arkkitehtuuri? - Miten tietoturva on varmistettu? - Mitä kielivaihtoehtoja järjestelmä tukee? Kokemukset ja referenssit - Onko hyvinvointialueilla/kunnissa ratkaisuanne käytössä? - Miten järjestelmän suoriutuu suuren organisaation palautevolyymista? - Voitteko toimittaa referenssitietoja järjestelmä asiakkaista? Lisätiedot - Mitä muita oleellisia ominaisuuksia ratkaisunne sisältää? - Miten järjestelmän käyttöönotto tyypillisesti toteutetaan? - Millaista tukea ja koulutusta tarjoatte? Hankintayksikkö varaa mahdollisuuden käydä Teams:lla järjestettäviä esittelytilaisuuksia tietopyyntöön/markkinavuoropuheluun vastanneiden kesken, mikäli hankintayksikkö katsoo sen tarpeelliseksi lisätietojen saamiseksi. Mahdollinen Teams-palaverin esittelyaika sisältää 30 minuuttia tarjottavan järjestelmän esittelyä ja 30 min keskustelua. Vastaukset kysymyksiin pyydetään lähettämään 30.9.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä. Vastaukset pyydetään lyhyesti ja informatiivisesti. Vastaukset pyydetään lähettämään osoitteeseen hankinnat@ekhva.fi.Viestin otsikko: Markkinakartoitus: Asiakaspalautejärjestelmä Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinakartoitukseen/tietopyyntöön osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (Toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kiittää etukäteen vastauksistanne. Ne ovat arvokkaita järjestelmätarpeidemme määrittelyssä ja mahdollisen hankinnan valmistelussa.

signals.description: Das Ziel der Exportinitiative Energie (EIE) des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) ist es, deutsche Unternehmen (UN), die klimafreundliche Energielösungen anbieten, beim Markteintritt im Ausland zu unterstützen und deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen international zu positionieren. Ein fester Bestandteil des Förderangebots ist das Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm. Ziel der Energie-Geschäftsreisen ist es, den Markteinstieg für deutsche KMU durch den Aufbau von fundierten Marktkenntnissen sowie die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung zu potenziellen Geschäftspartnern in den jeweiligen Zielmärkten vorzubereiten und bestehende Auslandsaktivitäten deutscher KMU weiter auszubauen. Das Fördermodul Energie-Geschäftsreise (GR) besteht aus einem Reisesteckbrief*, einer Zielmarktanalyse (ZMA*), einem Briefing vor Ort sowie einer Veranstaltung oder einer Kombination mehrerer Veranstaltungsformate*, die in Abhängigkeit von Zielmarkt und Themenschwerpunkt ausgewählt werden. Das zentrale Element der Maßnahme sind individuelle Gespräche der deutschen UN für eine gezielte Geschäftsanbahnung mit potenziellen Geschäftspartnern des Ziellandes. Lot LOT-0001: Los 1 - Bulgarien Nachhaltige Energieversorgung und Effizienzsteigerung in der Agrarwirtschaft. Zielland: Bulgarien Anwendungsfeld: Energieerzeugung Möglicher Termin: Q4 2027 Zielsetzung: Bei der GR soll die Identifikation und der Aufbau von Geschäftskontakten mit potenziellen Kunden im Zielmarkt im Fokus stehen. Daneben dient die Maßnahme der Darstellung der Leistungsfähigkeit deutscher Technologielösungen in diesem Bereich vor einem ausgewählten Fachpublikum. Der Aufbau von Geschäftskontakten soll im Rahmen individueller Kontaktgespräche erfolgen. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden. Lot LOT-0002: Los 2 - Estland, Lettland Smart Grids und Energiespeicher für die Integration erneuerbarer Energien. Zielland: Estland, Lettland Anwendungsfeld: Energieinfrastruktur und Elektromobilität Möglicher Termin: Q4 2027 Zielsetzung: Aufbauend auf eine frühere Maßnahme der EIE zum Technologieschwerpunkt zielt die GR darauf ab, deutsche Anbieter innovativer Technologien zu Smart Grids und Energiespeicher bei der Markterschließung und -festigung in Estland und Lettland zu unterstützen. Die Veranstaltungsformate sollten so gewählt werden, dass die gesamte Bandbreite und Qualität deutscher Technologielösungen dargestellt und so das Ansehen der deutschen Unternehmen als führende Anbieter klimafreundlicher Energielösungen gestärkt wird. Dafür bietet sich die Organisation einer Fachkonferenz in einem der Zielländer an, zu der Branchenvertreterinnen und -vertreter aus dem zweiten Zielland eingeladen werden. Alternativ ist die Kombination aus zwei unterschiedlichen Formaten in beiden Zielländern möglich – dabei ist darauf zu achten, dass diese inhaltlich und konzeptionell aufeinander aufbauen und abwechslungsreich sind. Der Aufbau von Geschäftskontakten soll im Rahmen individueller Kontaktgespräche in beiden Zielländern erfolgen. Hinweis: Es soll eine regionale ZMA (Sonderversion) erstellt werden, die Estland und Lettland umfasst. Es sind zwei individuelle Potenzialanalysen zu Estland und Lettland zu verfassen. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden. Lot LOT-0003: Los 3 - Griechenland Biomethan und Power-to-Gas: Schlüsseltechnolgien für Dekarbonisierung und Versorgungssicherheit. Zielland: Griechenland Anwendungsfeld: Energieerzeugung Möglicher Termin: Q4 2027 Zielsetzung: Die Maßnahme zielt darauf ab, deutsche Unternehmen der Biogasbranche frühzeitig im aufstrebenden griechischen Markt zu positionieren. Die Fachveranstaltung soll der Informationsvermittlung und Netzwerkbildung dienen und die Innovationskraft der deutschen Branche hervorheben. Der Aufbau von Geschäftskontakten erfolgt im Rahmen individueller Kontaktgespräche. Hinweis: Die Leistungsphase zur Erstellung einer Potenzialanalyse entfällt. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden. Lot LOT-0004: Los 4 - Niederlande Sicherheitstechnologien für kritische Offshore-Energieinfrastruktur. Zielland: Niederlande Anwendungsfeld: Energieinfrastruktur und Elektromobilität Möglicher Termin: Q3 2027 Zielsetzung: Die GR zielt darauf ab, deutsche Anbieter im genannten Themenbereich bei der Markterschließung und -festigung in den Niederlanden zu begleiten. Angesichts des spezifischen Themas ist eine sorgfältige Definition der anzusprechenden Zielgruppe in Deutschland vorzunehmen. Das gewählte Veranstaltungsformat soll die Leistungsfähigkeit deutscher Technologien in den Fokus rücken und ausreichend Raum für fachlichen Austausch im vertrauensvollen Rahmen bieten. Der klare Fokus sollte auf die Organisation von individuellen B2B-Gesprächen gelegt werden. Hinweis: Es soll eine längere ZMA verfasst werden (Sonderversion). Die Leistungsphase zur Erstellung einer Potenzialanalyse entfällt. Die im Leitfaden beschriebenen Vorgaben sind bei der Projektumsetzung anzuwenden. Lot LOT-0005: Los 5 - Norwegen Dekarbonisierung der Schifffahrt und maritimen Infrastruktur. Zielland: Norwegen Anwendungsfeld: Energieerzeugung Möglicher Termin: Q3 + Q4 2027 Zielsetzung: Aufbauend auf Wasserstoff-Maßnahmen der EIE in Norwegen in den vergangenen Jahren zielt die GR darauf ab, Partnerschaften zwischen deutschen und norwegischen Unternehmen anzubahnen. Die spezifischen Technologiebedarfe in Norwegen in Kombination mit einem hochtechnologisierten Marktumfeld erfordern eine tiefgehende Analyse des lokalen Wettbewerbsumfelds und der deutschen Angebotsseite im Vorfeld der GR. Das gewählte Veranstaltungsformat sollte die Innovationsfähigkeit der deutschen Branche betonen sowie fachlichen Austausch und Zugang zu Entscheidungsträgerinnen und -trägern ermöglichen. Der Schwerpunkt der GR liegt auf der Anbahnung von deutsch-norwegischem Kooperationen, der Kundensuche für deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie der Beteiligung deutscher Unternehmen an konkreten Projekten im Zielland. Hinweis: Die GR wird in Kombination mit einem WEB ausgeschrieben. Die Teilnahme am WEB ist unabhängig von einer Anmeldung zur GR. Ziel ist es, deutsche Unternehmen über den Zielmarkt und das Schwerpunktthema zu informieren und gleichzeitig das Interesse deutscher Unternehmen an einer Teilnahme an der bevorstehenden GR zu steigern. signals.description: Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Beauftragung eines leistungsfähigen Managed Service Providers (MSP), der die vollständige Planung, Steuerung, Umsetzung und betriebliche Überführung der Brownfield-Transformation der bestehenden SAP-ECC-Systemlandschaft auf SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition, im Rahmen von „RISE with SAP“ übernimmt. Gegenstand der Beauftragung ist eine ganzheitliche Transformations- und Betriebsleistung. Diese umfasst insbesondere die technische und fachliche Analyse der bestehenden Systemlandschaft, die SAP-S/4HANA-Conversion, die Überführung in die Private-Cloud-Umgebung, Testmigrationen und Datenkonvertierung, die Anpassung von Eigenentwicklungen, Add-ons und Schnittstellen sowie die Umsetzung und Optimierung der relevanten kaufmännischen Prozesse. Darüber hinaus sind SAP Fiori, Reporting und Embedded Analytics sowie die erforderlichen Integrationsleistungen, insbesondere unter Nutzung der SAP Business Technology Platform und der SAP Integration Suite, zu berücksichtigen. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Transformation einschließlich Tests, Cutover, Go-live, Hypercare, Schulungen und Übergabe in einen geregelten Betrieb und übernimmt anschließend die vereinbarten Managed Services sowie Betriebs-, Support- und Weiterentwicklungsleistungen. Dabei sind insbesondere der Clean-Core-Ansatz, die Aufrechterhaltung des laufenden Klinikbetriebs, die bestehenden Abhängigkeiten zu SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med, SAP HCM und weiteren Umsystemen sowie Anforderungen an Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und ein geordnetes Exit-Szenario zu berücksichtigen. Als vertragliche Grundlage ist der Abschluss eines EVB-IT Cloudvertrags vorgesehen, der sowohl die Transformations- und Einführungsleistungen bis zur Abnahme als auch die anschließend zu erbringenden Managed Services, Betriebs-, Support- und Weiterentwicklungsleistungen abbildet.

Die wesentlichen Ziele des neuen Einsatz-Management-Systems (EMS) im Winterdienst sind die gerichtsfeste Nachweisführung über die durchgeführten Einsätze im Rahmen der Verkehrssicherungspflicht, Einsatzauswertungen, die Leistungsabrechnung mit Fremdunternehmern und anderen Straßenbaulastträgern sowie eine effiziente Einsatzsteuerung mit Hilfe eines Echtzeit-Monitorings. Ferner sollen die Fahrer anhand von Routenführungsfunktionen im Winterdienst entlastet werden. Grundlage des neuen Einsatz-Management-Systems des Dezernates Betrieb und Verkehr Ost- und Westhessen ist die automatisierte Einsatzdatenerfassung in den ca. 140 Winterdienstfahrzeugen (Fahrzeuge von Hessen Mobil und Fremdunternehmer), die im Zuständigkeitsbereich der 16 Straßenmeistereien den Winterdienst durchführen. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt einen EVB-IT Servicevertrag (mit Systemlieferungsvertrag) mit bis zu 3 Verlängerungsoptionen à 12 Monate abzuschließen.

signals.description: Aufbau, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines integrierten VoC Feedback- und Analytics-Systems für die gesamte EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Umfasst die Erhebung, Auswertung und Darstellung von B2C- und B2B-Feedback sowie operative Support-KPIs, Trendanalysen und automatisierter Mustererkennung. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen für VoC / Feedback & Analytics der EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO). Der Auftragnehmer baut die VoC-Plattform auf, konfiguriert sämtliche Feedback-Instrumente (Post-Interaction-Surveys, IVR-CSAT, NPS, CES, B2B-Partner-Reviews, Agenten-Feedback-Loop) und richtet das operative KPI-Dashboard sowie das Musterwarnsystem (Pattern Alerting) ein. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Closed-Beta-Phase (Q4 2026) und die Go-live-Phase (Q1 2027) mit Hypercare-Support. Er übergibt nach geordnetem Wissenstransfer die operative Hoheit über das VoC-System und die Analytics-Plattform an das interne Team des Auftraggebers. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die datenschutzkonforme Datenerhebung (DSGVO, EU-Hosting, Pseudonymisierung), die API-Integration mit dem Ticketsystem und der Telefonie-Infrastruktur (vgl. Ziff. 5. der Leistungsbeschreibung), die WCAG 2.1-konforme Gestaltung aller Feedback-Oberflächen sowie vollständige Systemdokumentation, Schulung des internen Teams und einen strukturierten Übergabeplan für die eigenständige Systemhoheit.

signals.description: Bereitstellung, Implementierung, Betrieb und Wartung der vollständigen technischen Infrastruktur für die EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Umfasst alle Systeme vom Self-Service-Portal über das Ticketmanagement bis hin zu Telefonie, Knowledge Base und Identity Management. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen für die Technische Infrastruktur der EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO), das sog. Tooling. Der Auftragnehmer implementiert, konfiguriert und nimmt in Betrieb: das Ticket- und CRM-System, die Knowledge Base und das FAQ-Portal, den In-App-Bot (oder die Kompatibilität zur Auftraggeber-internen App-Bot Lösung), die Telefonie- und IVR-Infrastruktur, die Anbindung und Kompatibilität zu dem B2B Portal: EUDI Hub, das IAM-System, das zentrale Event-Log-System und das Schwärzungssystem. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Closed-Beta-Phase (Q4 2026) und die Go-Live-Phase (Q1 2027) mit Hypercare-Support und übergibt nach geordnetem Wissenstransfer die operative Systemhoheit an das interne Team des Auftraggebers. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die EU-konforme Infrastruktur ((ISO 27001), kein US-CLOUD-Act-Exposure), WCAG 21-Konformität aller Nutzer-Frontends, einen obligatorischen externen Penetrationstest vor Go-live sowie vollständige Systemdokumentation und Schulung des internen Teams.

Context and requirements Overview Summary of the work Healthcare Improvement Scotland seeks a supplier to design and deliver the next phase of its website development using a people-led, user-centred approach. Working within the existing WordPress platform, the supplier will undertake discovery, user research, information architecture, accessibility improvements, website development and capability building. The initial scope covers two directorates and will create reusable design patterns, templates and approaches for wider organisational adoption. Pricing model Fixed price Provide further information Confirm if you require a contracted out service or supply of resource Contracted out service: the off-payroll rules do not apply Organisation the work is for Healthcare Improvement Scotland - NHS Scotland Where you want the supplier to work Scotland Where you want the supplier to work No specific location (for example they can work remotely) Latest start date 2026-10-27 Expected contract length 0-08-00 Expected contract structure 8 months Estimated contract value (excl VAT) 170000 Budget details The anticipated budget for this opportunity is up to £170,000 excluding VAT. This is a fixed-price contract and must include all costs associated with delivery, including project management, user research, service design, WordPress development, accessibility testing, quality assurance, knowledge transfer, stakeholder engagement, travel, subsistence, overheads, licences and any other expenses. Suppliers will be required to submit a breakdown of costs by deliverable and milestone as part of their tender response About the work Why the work is being done Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) is seeking to improve the accessibility, usability and effectiveness of its website to better support health and social care professionals, partner organisations, citizens and communities across Scotland. User testing and stakeholder feedback have identified challenges relating to navigation, information architecture, content discovery and overall user experience. These issues can make it difficult for users to find and access important information, resources, tools, standards, frameworks and publications. HIS wishes to adopt a people-led, user-centred approach to improve access to information and digital services while building internal capability to sustainably manage and develop the website in the future. The project will focus initially on two directorates, creating reusable design patterns, templates and approaches that can subsequently be applied across the wider HIS web estate. The successful supplier will undertake discovery, user research, service design, accessibility improvement, WordPress development, implementation and knowledge transfer activities. The contract is expected to commence in November 2026 and all contracted deliverables must be completed by 30 June 2027. Problem to be solved Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) has identified challenges with the usability, accessibility and effectiveness of its website. User testing and stakeholder feedback have highlighted difficulties with navigation, information architecture, content discovery and overall user experience. These issues make it harder for users to find and access important information, resources, standards, tools, frameworks and publications, reducing engagement and limiting the impact of nationally important content. HIS is seeking a supplier to help create a more user-centred, accessible and sustainable digital service. Working within the existing WordPress platform, the supplier should focus on understanding user needs and applying a people-led design approach to improve how users find, access and interact with content. The initial scope focuses on two HIS directorates and aims to create reusable design patterns, templates, components and approaches that can later be adopted across the wider HIS web estate. The successful supplier will also be expected to build internal capability through knowledge transfer, coaching and guidance. The outcomes sought are: • Improved accessibility, usability and user experience. • Improved navigation and information architecture. • Improved discoverability and use of HIS resources and digital content. • Reusable website templates, components and design approaches. • Increased adoption and use of HIS programmes and resources. • Greater internal capability through knowledge transfer and coaching. • Sustainable content management, governance and maintenance arrangements. Challenges include working within an existing WordPress environment, balancing multiple stakeholder needs, delivering improvements within a fixed budget, and ensuring outputs developed for the initial scope can be scaled across the wider HIS website. Who the users are and what they need to do As a health and social care professional, I need to quickly find guidance, standards, frameworks, publications, tools and resources so that I can use Healthcare Improvement Scotland information in my work. As a citizen or community member, I need to access information about Healthcare Improvement Scotland and its work so that I can understand and engage with health and care improvement activities. As a website user, I need to find information quickly and easily so that I can access the resources, publications and content relevant to my needs. As a website user, I need intuitive navigation, accessible content and clear information architecture so that I can find information without needing detailed knowledge of Healthcare Improvement Scotland's organisational structure. As a HIS website editor, I need to create, update and manage website content efficiently so that information remains accurate, current and accessible. As a member of the HIS Communications Team, I need tools, templates and governance arrangements that support consistent and user-centred content management so that the website remains effective and up to date. As a member of the HIS Digital Team, I need sustainable website components, guidance and supporting documentation so that the website can be maintained and developed effectively. As a HIS employee responsible for managing and improving the website, I need knowledge transfer, coaching and capability development so that improvements can be sustained beyond the life of the contract. As a HIS stakeholder, I need website content, navigation and information architecture to reflect user needs so that users can easily locate the information they are seeking. Preliminary market engagement Work done so far Current phase Not started Existing team The successful supplier will work collaboratively with a range of stakeholders across Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS), including: Director of Evidence and Digital, and Chief Pharmacist – provides project oversight, strategic direction and overall accountability for delivery. Communications Team – key stakeholders responsible for website content, stakeholder communications and user engagement. Digital Team – responsible for digital services and ongoing management of the website and related technologies. Transformational Change – Systems Unit – responsible for contract management, project management and providing existing user-centred design expertise. Website Editors and Content Owners – staff located across the organisation who are responsible for maintaining, updating and managing website content. The successful supplier will be expected to work collaboratively with these stakeholders to shape, prioritise and deliver the work, undertake user engagement activities, and support knowledge transfer and capability building throughout the contract. Incumbent supplier No Provide further information Linked projects Work setup Working arrangements The successful supplier will be expected to work collaboratively with Healthcare Improvement Scotland (HIS) stakeholders throughout delivery of the contract. This will include regular engagement with the Director of Evidence and Digital and Chief Pharmacist, the Communications Team, the Digital Team, the Transformational Change – Systems Unit, and website editors and content owners across the organisation. The supplier will be expected to adopt a collaborative and flexible approach, working with HIS to agree priorities, delivery activities, milestones and outputs. Knowledge transfer, coaching and capability building are important elements of the requirement and suppliers should anticipate regular engagement with HIS staff throughout the contract. The Authority does not require a full-time on-site presence. Suppliers may propose a delivery approach that combines remote and on-site working where this supports effective stakeholder engagement, user research, workshops, training and project delivery. Any travel, subsistence, accommodation, overheads or other expenses associated with delivery of the contract must be included within the Total Contract Price submitted by the supplier. signals.description: Broad Horizons Education Trust is currently exploring options for the future provision of its payroll services commencing in September 2027. The Trust currently has an estimated headcount of 1408 employees across 18 sites/academies, processed on a monthly pay cycle. The purpose of this Request for Information is to engage with potential suppliers prior to any formal procurement to: Inform our procurement strategy, scope, and specification. Gauge market interest, capacity, and capabilities. Understand standard market pricing models, implementation timelines, and risk mitigation strategies. The primary objectives of this engagement are to: Gauge current market interest, capacity, and capabilities across service delivery models Seek supplier feedback to refine and finalize the procurement strategy, technical specification, and performance KPIs. Understand commercial and pricing models. Inform system integration requirements to ensure a successful go-live for September 2027. Key operational requirements include: Full and seamless transition Full management processing of monthly payrolls. Comprehensive public sector pension scheme administration, returns, and compliance-specifically Teachers' Pensions Scheme (TPS) and Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) Pay scales - To be able to cope with Teaching pay scales, support staff pay scale, apprenticeships plus off-scale pay grades where needed Pay awards and increments To be able to apply pay awards to current staff automatically For back pay to be automatically calculated To be able to chose to backdated pay awards to some leavers To be able to apply increments at different dates for some staff To be able to apply 'No Increment' for specific contracts Integration capability with existing HR and Finance systems and simple data input Integration with MIS - currently Arbor - to provide a 'single source of truth' from which reports and data flows Access for Employees - To efficiently be able to download payslips, P60s etc. To efficiently be able to update personal details, including bank account details Knowledge and experience working with MATs in the education sector. Please email procurement@bhetrust.co.uk for further details and a questionnaire. Lot 1: .

signals.description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η αναβάθμιση και επέκταση του Πολυκαναλικού συστήματος ενημέρωσης και εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555, το οποίο λειτουργεί από τη 1/10/2022, ως ενιαίος κόμβος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών και επιχειρήσεων για θέματα αρμοδιότητας του Υπουργείου Εργασίας και Κοινωνικής Ασφάλισης και των εποπτευομένων φορέων του. Στο πλαίσιο της αναβάθμισης, ενισχύεται η ψηφιακή αρχιτεκτονική και τα λογισμικά υποσυστήματα, όπως η διαδικτυακή πύλη, η γνωσιακή βάση, λύσεις τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και το ticketing, ώστε το 1555 να μεταβεί σταδιακά από ένα κυρίως φωνοκεντρικό μοντέλο σε ένα ισορροπημένο μοντέλο εξυπηρέτησης, όπου οι πιο σύνθετες και ευαίσθητες υποθέσεις παραμένουν σε ανθρώπινη εξυπηρέτηση, με ενίσχυση εξειδικευμένων εκπροσώπων, ενώ, οι απλούστερες υποθέσεις κλείνουν μέσω self service υπηρεσιών και αυτοματισμών. Ειδικότερα, προβλέπεται αξιοποίηση λύσεων ΑΙ τόσο προς τον πολίτη, όσο και προς τον εκπρόσωπο, όπως IVR και ΑΙ agent για αναγνώριση προθέσεων και δρομολόγηση σε ψηφιακές λύσεις ή στους κατάλληλους εξειδικευμένους εκπροσώπους, εργαλεία agent assist που αντλούν περιεχόμενο από τη γνωσιακή βάση για μείωση λαθών και χρόνου χειρισμού, καθώς και analytics για κατανόηση αιτημάτων και καλύτερο σχεδιασμό στελέχωσης. Παράλληλα, ενισχύεται η διαλειτουργικότητα σε επίπεδο υποδομών ή και services με το Σύστημα Διαχείρισης Αιτημάτων Πολιτών (CC ticketing) και η αξιοποίηση δεδομένων από το ticketing και τη γνωσιακή βάση, με πρόβλεψη συνεχούς βελτίωσης μέσω ανατροφοδότησης και ανάλυσης συνομιλιών. Η λειτουργία των εξειδικευμένων συμβούλων θα επεκταθεί και θα ενισχυθεί, ώστε οι πολίτες να έχουν ακόμα μεγαλύτερη πρόσβαση σε προσωποποιημένη πληροφόρηση. Τα ψηφιακά συστήματα θα αναβαθμιστούν περαιτέρω και θα εισαχθούν και νέα, με στόχο την ενίσχυση της εξυπηρέτησης. Ομάδα εμπειρογνωμόνων θα μπορεί να πραγματοποιεί στοχευμένες μελέτες σε ειδική θεματολογία των εξυπηρετούμενων Φορέων, καθώς και θα μπορούν να πραγματοποιούνται έρευνες, ώστε να ενισχύονται περαιτέρω και οι Φορείς μέσα από το έργο. Η ανάπτυξη και η διαχείριση του έργου γίνεται σε πακέτα εργασίας ως ακολούθως : I. I. Δομή επικοινωνίας και εξυπηρέτησης κοινού II. Τεχνικές Υποδομές III. Έρευνες ικανοποίησης και Διασφάλιση ποιότητας IV. Ενίσχυση φορέων σε θεματολογία – ειδικές έρευνες V. Διαχείριση έργου VI. Εκπαίδευση στην εξυπηρέτηση Αναβάθμιση και επέκταση πολυκαναλικού συστήματος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555

The proposed requirement may include: - a configurable and secure case-management platform; - customer submission and identity-verification capability or integration; - configurable workflows, case administration, deadline management and auditability; - document handling, processing and redaction capability; - management information and operational reporting; - integration with Authority-approved services, systems and platforms; - configuration, implementation and testing; - migration from existing systems and repositories; - training, transition, go-live and service stabilisation; - ongoing managed-service, support, maintenance, security and resilience; and - exit and transition-out support. The Authority currently intends to conduct a two-stage Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023. signals.description: The British Business Bank is undertaking pre-market engagement to inform a potential future procurement for a Legal Case Management System. The Bank’s Legal team has identified a need to improve how legal matters, disputes, litigation deadlines, correspondence, advice and related documentation are recorded, managed and accessed. Current ways of working rely heavily on email, shared drives, individual knowledge and manual tracking, which creates operational, compliance and continuity risks. The purpose of this engagement is to test market capability and inform the scope, approach and commercial model for a potential Legal Case Management System that can support matter management, deadline tracking, secure document and correspondence management, knowledge reuse, reporting, Microsoft 365 integration and information governance requirements. The estimated contract value will be determined following completion of the engagement exercise, hence the current £0 value within this notice. signals.description: Background Innovate UK Business Connect brings together businesses, researchers, investors and partners to accelerate innovation across the UK. As part of UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), and a strategic delivery partner to Innovate UK, we connect organisations to funding opportunities, partnerships and expertise to help ideas move from concept to scale. One of the key tools for making these connections is events. We deliver a diverse portfolio of in-person, virtual and hybrid events, ranging from webinars and workshops to large-scale conferences and exhibitions. To support the effective planning, delivery and evaluation of these events, we are seeking proposals from suppliers who can provide a modern event management system that streamlines event operations, enhances the participant experience and supports data-driven decision-making. Description of work Innovate UK Business Connect is seeking tenders from providers who can supply a single event management system that supports the end-to-end event lifecycle, including event creation, registration management, attendee communications, speaker and exhibitor management, networking, reporting and post-event evaluation. The system should integrate with existing business systems where required and provide a single source of truth for event delivery teams. This aligns with the organisation's wider objective of ensuring events are outcome-led, measurable and supported by efficient registration, communication and reporting processes. The event management system should: • Deliver an intuitive and user-friendly delegate journey from registration through to post-event follow-up • Improve the event experience for speakers and exhibitors • Reduce manual administration and improve operational efficiency • Provide real-time visibility of registrations, attendance, engagement and event performance • Support both virtual and in-person event delivery models • Enable consistent data capture and reporting to demonstrate event impact and ROI • Support accessibility, compliance and data protection requirements The platform must support multiple user roles and permission levels to reflect different operational needs across the organisation. As a minimum, the system should accommodate the following user groups: • Event Managers o Full end-to-end event management capabilities o Creation, configuration and administration of events o Management of registrations, attendee communications, speakers and exhibitors o Access to event-level reporting, analytics and post-event evaluation data • Marketing Managers o Access to update and manage event webpages and associated content o Access to registration, engagement and performance reporting • Integrated Systems o Administration of integrations between the event management platform and our CRM system (Workbooks) o Management of data flows, field mapping, data quality and synchronisation processes o Access to reporting, data exports and system configuration relating to integrations • System Administrators o A small number of designated super users (typically two to three individuals) o Full platform administration rights, including user management, permissions, integrations, security settings and system configuration We deliver a large and diverse portfolio of business-to-business events. Historically, this has included more than 300 events per year and generating approximately 60,000 delegate registrations annually. The event management platform must be capable of supporting a range of event formats, scales and audience sizes, including: • In person events: We deliver approximately 100 in-person events each year, typically attracting between 30 and 2,000 delegates to each. Most events are free to attend and may span one or more days. We do not require onsite event delivery support from the appointment supplier; however the platform must provide the functionality and tools to enable our team to manage attendee registration and onsite event operations, and provide a seamless and efficient onsite experience for attendees • Online Events: We deliver close to 200 fully online events annually. The majority are webinars, including webinar series and interactive workshops. We also run a small number of larger-scale virtual conferences and exhibitions, some of which take place over multiple days. The platform should provide a seamless user experience for both organisers and attendees and support the delivery of events of varying size and complexity. • Hybrid: A smaller proportion of our events are hybrid, combining in-person and virtual attendance. The platform should support hybrid event delivery and provide a consistent registration, communication and reporting experience across both audience groups. The proposed solution must be capable of supporting this volume of activity while providing robust registration management, attendee communications, data integration, reporting and analytics across all event formats. Timings This is a two-stage evaluation process. We will do an initially score of each supplier bid with the top two or three scoring suppliers invited to provide a demonstration. This will be the opportunity for the selected suppliers to demonstrate the setup of an event using a given scenario. Anticipated timeline: • October: demo • November: final evaluation • November - December: Contract is awarded • 1 April 2027: Contract starts • April - September: Onboarding, training, templates created and integrations built • September onwards: Events start to be managed from the platform Cost The maximum value of this requirement over the three-year period is a maximum of £600,000.00 excluding VAT. This contract is structured as an initial two-year period with a maximum budget of £400,000.00 excluding VAT with an optional 12-month extension valued at maximum £200,000.00 excluding VAT. Submission In response to this tender, please provide the information listed below. • Short narrative describing your overall approach to working with Innovate UK Business Connect • Checklist against the requirements • Supporting information against the essential requirements • A rate card of costs associated with services you provide • A completed copy of the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire including: o A copy of your audited accounts for the most recent two years (or alternative means of demonstrating financial status if trading for less than a year) • Legal information i.e. Your standard T&Cs Please provide the information requested above to re.support@iukbc.org.uk by 17:00 10 October 2026 at the latest. IR35 will be assessed before the awarding of a successful contract. Submissions sent without relevant documents as listed above will be automatically rejected. Innovate UK Business Connect may require successful submissions to be subject to non-disclosure agreements. Evaluation structure Submissions will be scored against the following areas: • Value for money - 20% • Technical specification - 70% o alignment to objective 10% o essential requirements 40% o desirable requirements 20% • Demonstration - 10% Lot 1: .

signals.description: Technische Erneuerung und digitale Erweiterung des Parksystems für Smart Parking Lot LOT-0000: Stadtgebiet Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Smart Parking - Parksystem für Smart Parking. Gegenstand ist die technische Erneuerung und digitale Erweiterung der bestehenden Parkierungssysteme an 5 Standorten der Kur- und Kongreß-GmbH Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe sowie die Kompletterneuerung des Parkierungssystems im Karstadt-Parkhaus. Ziel ist eine moderne, serviceorientierte und funktional einheitliche Parkinfrastruktur. Die bestehenden Anlagen sollen so ergänzt werden, dass moderne digitale Parkprozesse auf Basis von Kennzeichenerkennung, QR-Code-Funktionen, bargeldloser Webzahlung, digitaler Rabattierung sowie Self-Service-Funktionen für Kurzzeit- und Dauerparker durchgängig und standortübergreifend genutzt werden können. Es soll kein isolierter Austausch einzelner Geräte erfolgen, sondern die funktionsfähige Erweiterung eines bereits vorhandenen Gesamtsystems. Leistungsbestandteile: Lieferung, Montage, Integration, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme der Komponenten an allen Standorten; Bereitstellung und Einrichtung der zentralen Software- und Leitrechnerkomponenten. Technische Anforderungen und Integration: - Alle Komponenten müssen über die bestehende Leitrechner-/ Zellenrechner-Topologie zentral verwaltbar sein. - Ein durchgängiger Parkvorgang (Einfahrt - Identifikation über Ticket, Kennzeichen oder QR-Code - Bezahlung an Automaten/Webdienst/Rabattstelle - Ausfahrt - revisionssichere Abrechnung) muss systemübergreifend gewährleistet sein. - Schnittstellen, Firmware-/Backend-Stände und Datenmodelle sind herstellerseitig abgestimmt bereitzustellen. Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme: - Montage und Inbetriebnahme im laufenden Betrieb unter Minimierung von Ausfallzeiten; Koordination mit dem Projektsteuerer. - Abnahmekriterien und Teilabnahmen: Teilabnahme je Standort nach erfolgreichem Funktions-/Integrationstest; förmliche Gesamtabnahme nach vollständiger Systemintegration. Sonstige Leistungen: - Vollständige technische Dokumentation in deutscher Sprache. - Einweisung / Schulung des Personals: Einweisung des Betriebspersonals je Standort sowie Administrator-Schulung für das Leitrechnersystem. Für die Wartung der Anlagen ist ein Wartungsvertrag zu schließen, welcher folgende Bereiche abdeckt: Software, Leit-/Zellenrechner, Verfügbarkeit eines 24/7 erreichbaren technischen Servicecenter, Bereitschaftsdienst für Vor-Ort Wartung & Reparatur.

signals.description: Nordværk I/S udbyder anskaffelse, implementering og efterfølgende drift og vedligeholdelse af et nyt fagsystem til administration og understøttelse af affaldsindsamlingen, herefter benævnt Løsningen. Anskaffelsen gennemføres med henblik på at erstatte den nuværende systemunderstøttelse af Nordværks renovationsområde og etablere en samlet, tidssvarende og fremtidssikret Løsning, der kan understøtte de forretningsprocesser, som knytter sig til administration, planlægning, sagsbehandling, udførelse, registrering, opfølgning og dokumentation af affaldsindsamlingen. Anskaffelsen omfatter levering og implementering af Løsningen samt de ydelser, der er nødvendige for at etablere og tage Løsningen i brug. Dette omfatter blandt andet afklaring og konfiguration, migrering og etablering af relevante data, etablering og tilpasning af Integrationer, test, uddannelse, dokumentation, idriftsættelse samt efterfølgende drift, support, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen skal understøtte Nordværks samlede værdikæde på renovationsområdet fra en borgers eller kundes ordning, henvendelse eller bestilling til planlægning og udførelse af den konkrete renovationsopgave samt efterfølgende registrering, sagsbehandling, opfølgning, controlling, dokumentation og grundlag for afregning. Anskaffelsen indgår i Nordværks arbejde med at sikre en effektiv, sammenhængende og datadrevet administration og drift af affaldsindsamlingen. Løsningen skal understøtte standardiserede og kontrollerbare arbejdsgange, høj datakvalitet, reduceret behov for manuelle processer samt bedre muligheder for styring, opfølgning og løbende udvikling af renovationsområdet. Løsningen skal samtidig kunne indgå hensigtsmæssigt i Nordværks øvrige systemlandskab og understøtte organisatoriske, driftsmæssige og teknologiske ændringer over Kontraktens løbetid. Løsningens overordnede formål er navnlig: i) at understøtte sammenhængende og effektive arbejdsgange inden for kundeadministration, sagsbehandling, driftsplanlægning, opgaveudførelse, registrering, controlling og opfølgning, ii) at understøtte den operationelle affaldsindsamling for både Nordværks egne og eksterne renovatører, herunder planlægning, ruter, Navigation, registrering af udførte opgaver, håndtering af afvigelser og driftsmæssig opfølgning, og iii) at etablere et fleksibelt og fremtidssikret systemgrundlag med høj datakvalitet og gode muligheder for integration, konfiguration, automatisering, rapportering og løbende videreudvikling. De forretningsprocesser og den funktionalitet, der er gældende for Løsningen, er nærmere beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Løsningen forventes at skulle understøtte flere forskellige interne og eksterne brugergrupper. Dette omfatter blandt andet ca. 186-200 interne renovationsmedarbejdere, 55-65 administrative medarbejdere, 10-20 administratorer/superbrugere, 40-50 administrative brugere hos eksterne renovatører samt 100-110 renovationsmedarbejdere hos eksterne renovatører. Brugergrupperne vil have forskellige roller og adgangsbehov i Løsningen. Løsningen skal etableres på en teknisk platform, der understøtter de krav til tilgængelighed, sikkerhed, integration, skalerbarhed, drift og videreudvikling, der fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. De nærmere tekniske krav til Løsningen og dens etablering fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Løsningen skal have en åben, gennemsigtig og veldokumenteret arkitektur og skal kunne indgå i Nordværks samlede systemlandskab. Leverandøren skal levere og vedligeholde den Dokumentation, der er nødvendig for blandt andet drift, administration, Integrationer, konfiguration, fejlsøgning og videreudvikling af Løsningen, i overensstemmelse med kravene i Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen understøtter forretningskritiske processer i forbindelse med den daglige administration og udførelse af affaldsindsamlingen. Der stilles derfor krav til blandt andet Løsningens tilgængelighed, stabilitet, sikkerhed, sporbarhed og dataintegritet, således at data og registreringer kan anvendes pålideligt i den operationelle drift, kundebetjening, sagsbehandling, controlling, dokumentation og som grundlag for afregning. Løsningen skal integreres med en række af Nordværks øvrige systemer og tekniske løsninger. Dette omfatter blandt andet relevante snitflader til afregningssystem, GIS- og datagrundlag, selvbetjeningsløsninger, registreringsudstyr, vejesystemer og øvrige tredjepartsløsninger, hvor dataudveksling er nødvendig for at understøtte sammenhængende arbejdsgange. De konkrete krav til Integrationer og snitflader fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Udbuddet indeholder endvidere en række optioner på yderligere funktionalitet og leverancer, som Nordværk kan vælge at gøre brug af i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten. De konkrete optioner og vilkårene herfor fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag, herunder Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Ibrugtagning af Løsningen skal ske efter gennemførelse af de aftalte aktiviteter vedrørende blandt andet afklaring, konfiguration, datamigrering, Integrationer, test, uddannelse og godkendelse. Den nærmere fremgangsmåde og tidsplan for implementering og Ibrugtagning fastlægges i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og de relevante bilag. Kontrakten indeholder således en implementeringsperiode på op til 12 måneder samt efter Ibrugtagning en driftsperiode på 6 år med mulighed for forlængelse på 2 gange 12 måneder. Nordværk I/S udbyder anskaffelse, implementering og efterfølgende drift og vedligeholdelse af et nyt fagsystem til administration og understøttelse af affaldsindsamlingen, herefter benævnt Løsningen. Anskaffelsen gennemføres med henblik på at erstatte den nuværende systemunderstøttelse af Nordværks renovationsområde og etablere en samlet, tidssvarende og fremtidssikret Løsning, der kan understøtte de forretningsprocesser, som knytter sig til administration, planlægning, sagsbehandling, udførelse, registrering, opfølgning og dokumentation af affaldsindsamlingen. Anskaffelsen omfatter levering og implementering af Løsningen samt de ydelser, der er nødvendige for at etablere og tage Løsningen i brug. Dette omfatter blandt andet afklaring og konfiguration, migrering og etablering af relevante data, etablering og tilpasning af Integrationer, test, uddannelse, dokumentation, idriftsættelse samt efterfølgende drift, support, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen skal understøtte Nordværks samlede værdikæde på renovationsområdet fra en borgers eller kundes ordning, henvendelse eller bestilling til planlægning og udførelse af den konkrete renovationsopgave samt efterfølgende registrering, sagsbehandling, opfølgning, controlling, dokumentation og grundlag for afregning. Anskaffelsen indgår i Nordværks arbejde med at sikre en effektiv, sammenhængende og datadrevet administration og drift af affaldsindsamlingen. Løsningen skal understøtte standardiserede og kontrollerbare arbejdsgange, høj datakvalitet, reduceret behov for manuelle processer samt bedre muligheder for styring, opfølgning og løbende udvikling af renovationsområdet. Løsningen skal samtidig kunne indgå hensigtsmæssigt i Nordværks øvrige systemlandskab og understøtte organisatoriske, driftsmæssige og teknologiske ændringer over Kontraktens løbetid. Løsningens overordnede formål er navnlig: i) at understøtte sammenhængende og effektive arbejdsgange inden for kundeadministration, sagsbehandling, driftsplanlægning, opgaveudførelse, registrering, controlling og opfølgning, ii) at understøtte den operationelle affaldsindsamling for både Nordværks egne og eksterne renovatører, herunder planlægning, ruter, Navigation, registrering af udførte opgaver, håndtering af afvigelser og driftsmæssig opfølgning, og iii) at etablere et fleksibelt og fremtidssikret systemgrundlag med høj datakvalitet og gode muligheder for integration, konfiguration, automatisering, rapportering og løbende videreudvikling. De forretningsprocesser og den funktionalitet, der er gældende for Løsningen, er nærmere beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Løsningen forventes at skulle understøtte flere forskellige interne og eksterne brugergrupper. Dette omfatter blandt andet ca. 186-200 interne renovationsmedarbejdere, 55-65 administrative medarbejdere, 10-20 administratorer/superbrugere, 40-50 administrative brugere hos eksterne renovatører samt 100-110 renovationsmedarbejdere hos eksterne re-novatører. Brugergrupperne vil have forskellige roller og adgangsbehov i Løsningen. Løsningen skal etableres på en teknisk platform, der understøtter de krav til tilgængelighed, sikkerhed, integration, skalerbarhed, drift og videreudvikling, der fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. De nærmere tekniske krav til Løsningen og dens etablering fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Løsningen skal have en åben, gennemsigtig og veldokumenteret arkitektur og skal kunne indgå i Nordværks samlede systemlandskab. Leverandøren skal levere og vedligeholde den Dokumentation, der er nødvendig for blandt andet drift, administration, Integrationer, konfiguration, fejlsøgning og videreudvikling af Løsningen, i overensstemmelse med kravene i Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen understøtter forretningskritiske processer i forbindelse med den daglige administration og udførelse af affaldsindsamlingen. Der stilles derfor krav til blandt andet Løsningens tilgængelighed, stabilitet, sikkerhed, sporbarhed og dataintegritet, således at data og registreringer kan anvendes pålideligt i den operationelle drift, kundebetjening, sagsbehandling, controlling, dokumentation og som grundlag for afregning. Løsningen skal integreres med en række af Nordværks øvrige systemer og tekniske løsninger. Dette omfatter blandt andet relevante snitflader til afregningssystem, GIS- og datagrundlag, selvbetjeningsløsninger, registreringsudstyr, vejesystemer og øvrige tredjepartsløsninger, hvor dataudveksling er nødvendig for at understøtte sammenhængende arbejdsgange. De konkrete krav til Integrationer og snitflader fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Udbuddet indeholder endvidere en række optioner på yderligere funktionalitet og leverancer, som Nordværk kan vælge at gøre brug af i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten. De konkrete optioner og vilkårene herfor fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag, herunder Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Ibrugtagning af Løsningen skal ske efter gennemførelse af de aftalte aktiviteter vedrørende blandt andet afklaring, konfiguration, datamigrering, Integrationer, test, uddannelse og godkendelse. Den nærmere fremgangsmåde og tidsplan for implementering og Ibrugtagning fastlægges i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og de relevante bilag. Kontrakten indeholder således en implementeringsperiode på op til 12 måneder samt efter Ibrugtagning en driftsperiode på 6 år med mulighed for forlængelse på 2 gange 12 måneder. Renovationssystemet, som nævnt under punkt 3, er udbudt særskilt. Renovationssystemet opdeles ikke i delaftaler af økonomiske og markedsmæssige hensyn, herunder at det vil være uhensigtsmæssigt for Nordværk med flere udviklingsleverandører.

signals.description: Fairhive Homes Limited intends to procure a contract for the supply, implementation, configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement of a Learning Management System. The procurement is intended to support Fairhive's requirement for an LMS platform that enables effective learning management, compliance training, reporting, user administration and integration with Fairhive's wider systems environment. The RFQ states that Fairhive wishes to appoint a single supplier to provide, implement, configure, support and maintain the LMS in accordance with the specification. The requirement is expected to include: 1. Supply of a hosted Learning Management System platform. 2. Configuration of workflows, roles, permissions, learning pathways, dashboards, notifications and branding. 3. Implementation support, including mobilisation, discovery, implementation planning, testing, user acceptance testing, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Data migration support, including extraction support, mapping, cleansing support, migration, reconciliation and validation. 5. Microsoft Entra ID Single Sign-On and user provisioning integration. 6. Microsoft 365 integrations, including Microsoft Teams and Outlook calendar integration. 7. Administrator, manager and end-user training, including materials and train-the-trainer or digital resources. 8. Initial content and SCORM set-up, including upload, configuration and validation of SCORM 1.2/2004 and other agreed content. 9. Ongoing hosting, storage, backups, disaster recovery, support, service levels, maintenance, updates, escalation and account management. 10. Reporting, dashboards and scheduled reporting. Suppliers will be expected to demonstrate: 1. Relevant experience implementing and supporting Learning Management Systems for a housing association, public sector organisation or similarly regulated environment. 2. A functional solution that supports learning pathways, compliance training management, reporting and dashboards, certification, SCORM compliance, accessibility, mobile functionality, workflow automation, manager functionality, learner experience and Microsoft 365 integration. 3. A clear implementation, data migration and training methodology, including project mobilisation, configuration, testing, user acceptance testing, data migration, training, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Robust information security, compliance and business continuity arrangements, including ISO27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, UK GDPR compliance, data hosting, resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and incident management. 5. Effective support, service desk, account management, service level, escalation, reporting, quarterly review, product roadmap and continuous improvement arrangements. 6. Measurable social value and sustainability commitments, including community investment, skills and employment support, carbon reduction, digital inclusion, volunteering, equality, diversity and inclusion, supplier diversity and wider environmental sustainability initiatives. Fairhive intends to use the procurement documentation and evaluation process to assess the optimum combination of quality, social value and price. The RFQ defines Most Advantageous Tender as the tender offering the optimum combination of quality, social value and price in accordance with the evaluation methodology. Particular emphasis is expected to be placed on: 1. Functional LMS capability and user experience. 2. Compliance training management and reporting. 3. Data security, UK GDPR compliance and hosting arrangements. 4. Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID integration. 5. Implementation, data migration and training support. 6. Service desk, support, service levels and account management. 7. Social value, sustainability and measurable community benefits. Lot 1: .

signals.description: NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership (NWSSP), hosted by Velindre University NHS Trust, are issuing this Market Engagement Notice to engage with the suppliers to gather feedback on market capabilities and capacity for the provision of managed services to support the operation of a finance, procurement and warehouse management system. The Central Team eBusiness Services (CTeS), within NWSSP, manage and supervise several core national enterprise systems which are used by Health Boards, Trusts, Special Heath Authorities, and Hosted Organisations, in Wales. These systems are collectively known as the FMS Enterprise System and include: - An e-Business Application System, including auxiliary services, which is facilitated through the Oracle eBusiness suite. - A Business Intelligence (BI) reporting system, facilitated through Qlik Sense. - An OCR Intelligent Scanning Management System - A Warehouse Management System - Other BI Reporting Systems The purpose of this market engagement exercise is to gather greater insight into the market’s capacity and capabilities in relation to provision of managed services and NWSSP are specifically seeking engagement from suppliers who are e-Business Suite experts with supply chain capabilities specifically covering warehouse management and who can also support to roll out and further development of discrete manufacturing processes within a regulated environment. The analysis of feedback obtained from this exercise will allow NWSSP to further develop its strategy and refine its service delivery requirements ahead of any potential procurement. The main objectives of this exercise are to: - Assess the level of interest in the marketplace from suppliers who can support the Oracle eBusiness Suite (EBS), - Test market capability and capacity, - Validate the proposed scope and service model, - Understand delivery approaches, innovations and commercial models and indicative rates, and - Explore development and innovation in relation to AI and the benefits that may be realised with its deployment through the Oracle eBusiness Suite. The provision of the Oracle EBS is facilitated through existing perpetual licences, and the scope of this engagement exercise does not include migrating the e-Business Application System to a Software as a Service (SaaS) model. This exercise is not a formal procurement process, does not constitute a call for competition and does not commit NHS Wales to any future procurement. However, information gathered through this engagement will help inform the development, scope and future direction of the project. Suppliers can express their interest in this process and request a copy of the Market Engagement Briefing Document, which contains further details on the requirement and engagement process, by contacting Chris Squires (christopher.squires@wales.nhs.uk). When submitting an expression of interest, suppliers are requested to confirm that they acknowledge and understand that: - the proposed managed service requirement relates specifically to Oracle E-Business Suite (Oracle EBS) and does not include support for Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions; - they have the necessary supply chain capabilities to support the requirements of the service; and - they possess the capability and expertise to support the development of warehouse management systems within discrete manufacturing environments. Suppliers will have the opportunity to participate in a structured engagement session which are scheduled for the 5th, 8th and 14th October. There are 10 sessions available and these will be allocated on a first come first served basis. However, NWSSP reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to make additional sessions available should there be sufficient interest from the market. No guarantee is given that additional sessions will be offered. Lot 1: . None

signals.description: Further to the UK1 Pipeline Notice published on 19th November 2025 by BlueLight Commercial Limited (ref: 2025/S 000-077692) in relation to a Victim & Citizen Engagement Technology Solution which will be used by UK law enforcement agencies, this UK2 Preliminary Market Engagement Notice is issued to inform the market of a potential future opportunity. This Pre-Market Engagement Notice is issued solely for the purposes of information gathering and engagement with the market. It does not constitute a call for competition and create any obligation on the Authority to proceed with a procurement exercise, or enter into any commercial arrangement. Please note the procurement route and anticipated publication date for this opportunity are yet to be determined. These elements will be confirmed following completion of the market engagement process and development of the Authority’s commercial strategy. Any future procurement will be subject to separate formal notice and the publication of full procurement documentation via the Find a Tender Service (FTS). BlueLight Commercial Limited (BLC) are conducting Preliminary Market Engagement to gain a better understanding of the market, supplier appetite, capacity, and capability, as well as perceived risks and opportunities. Any learnings will be used to formulate the associated procurement strategy. BLC work in collaboration with blue light organisations to maximise commercial benefit to UK emergency services. The focus of this solution will be improving Victim & Citizen Engagement, building trust and confidence, reducing demand within control rooms, and reducing the costs of serving the public by using innovative software to keep both victims and citizens more engaged. The aim is to ensure all forces have access to the most effective, reliable, and innovative solutions available in the market. This Solution needs to facilitate the force contact engagement from first contact with a police force to final closure of the contact, and via integration with police systems, e.g. Command and Control, Records Management Systems providing contact and updates throughout the journey without the need to call the force contact centre. It seeks to further drive standardisation and consistency, whilst helping forces to develop capability and invest in technology which will not only improve the service at first point of contact but will improve the overall contact experience. This Solution must facilitate Victim & Citizen engagement to reduce failure demand whilst proactively engaging to ensure high levels of customer (internal and external) trust and confidence. The delivery of the desired solution may be considered to follow the same customer service path as an online application or ordering process. For example, acknowledgement of the initial contact, time appropriate follow up contacts at defined points within the communication journey, and a closure contact at the end of the process. All communication will be auditable and align with the Victims code as appropriate. We are looking for solutions that can meet individual force needs and achieve the following: *Improve experience of members of the public accessing the policing service *Provide the public with consistent updates in a timely manner, *Improve public trust, confidence, and satisfaction, *Reduce Contact Management demand, *Improve force's overall Contact Management performance. signals.description: Automation Marketplace DPS Intelligent automation services and solutions, including automation technologies, services, consultancy and licences. Updates 26/09/24: We have extended this agreement until November 2026. You will be able to buy and run tenders for services until the new expiry date. Description A Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) that offers automation services and licences for use by the public sector, including their associated bodies and agencies. Automation services are needed to streamline processes and systems for public sector customers. The agreement offers the following services: strategy and business transformation problem solving with tech solutions resources and training software licences What is out of scope? Products and services out of scope include but are not limited to: any hardware and infrastructure hosting networks or connectivity services Benefits accessible route for suppliers – accessible for all suppliers (including SMEs) and suppliers can apply to join at any time government specific terms and conditions (Ts&Cs) – these have been created based on an agile approach using the public sector contract a dynamic filtering system – giving buyers flexibility based on their requirements. Suppliers receive notifications of competitions that are relevant to their service offering and buyers can easily identify potential eligible suppliers supports innovation – suppliers can add new services (within scope) during the lifetime of the DPS, meaning buyers can keep up with fast-moving market developments open to all public sector buyers – including central government departments and the wider public sector access to Cabinet Office (CO) automation task force – receive advice and support from the task force who specialise in the implementation of automation technologies, services and licences Products and suppliers Please read the 'How to buy' tab below for detailed instructions on how to find out which suppliers are on this agreement. Lot 1: Automation Marketplace DPS Understanding the opportunity, setting a strategic direction and target operating models. This filter allows buyers to build an evidence base and the sub-filters are areas to focus on. Expires: 15/11/2026 How to buy You must run a mini competition to select a supplier. There is no option for direct award. Before running your mini competition, find out which suppliers could meet your requirements using the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) Marketplace. The steps below outline how to search for suppliers, create a shortlist and carry out a mini competition. Register as a buyer on the Dynamic Purchasing System Marketplace. Note: although pages are headed ‘Supplier registration’ this is also where you can register as a buyer. Navigate to the Automation Marketplace DPS under Technology, choose the ‘Access as a buyer’ option and confirm your acceptance of the customer access agreement. On your ‘Manage your DPS Category Exports’ page you now have 2 options: view appointed suppliers click on the link to create a new category export. This is how you filter the suppliers that can meet your requirements. When creating a new category use the filtering tool (select all that apply) to specify your requirements and create your supplier shortlist. Save your filtered list of capable suppliers by clicking the ‘Save Category’ option and give the shortlist a unique name specific to your competition. From your ‘Manage your Category Exports’ page you can then export the list of suppliers and contact details (export is to an Excel spreadsheet) Quit the DPS. Use the list to run a Further Competition. Invite the suppliers identified by the DPS to bid against your detailed specification, evaluation criteria and contract format. The list is valid for only 2 working days , from the date of its creation, because new suppliers may apply to join at any point. If your Call for Competition excludes eligible suppliers it potentially breaches procurement regulations. You will need to get a fresh supplier list (steps 3.2 to 5) if you don’t use your list within 2 working days by clicking the ‘Search Again’ option for your export. You can use our eSourcing tool to run a Call for Competition. The tool is free to use for public sector buyers, or you can use your organisation’s own procurement tool. Your tender process should be proportionate to the value and complexity of your requirement. suppliers will need a reasonable period of time to review and prepare a response. This includes allowing sufficient time for suppliers to ask clarification questions and consider your answers before the deadline for written responses. Evaluate the responses. Request from the winning supplier(s) any required evidence that they can meet your requirements. Set a 2-day deadline for submitting evidence. If you’re satisfied with the evidence, award the contract Where appropriate, notify of the award on Contracts Finder. Contact Our customer services team is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Email the team if you need help completing your procurement or call 0345 410 2222 Documents Updates Crown Commercial Service (CCS) became Government Commercial Agency (GCA) on 1 April 2026. Documents published before this date may still refer to CCS. All contract documents remain valid for existing and new contracts, and there are no changes to how you work with us. For more information on framework durations, see the original Find a Tender Notice . You can email info@gca.gov.uk if you have any questions. RM6347.2 allows all public sector organisations to buy: professional services transport data services electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure smart ticketing and payment systems parking management solutions artificial intelligence (AI) powered traffic management tools environmental monitoring systems network management solutions transport infrastructure for road, rail, aviation and behavioural initiatives to prevent trespassing, property damage, theft and anti-social behaviour to enhance security to monitor vehicles to detect and manage moving traffic offences for incident safety and emergency response Lot 6: Zero emission vehicle infrastructure: electric vehicle infrastructure such as: professional services vehicle charging points back end platforms energy generation hardware for on-vehicle or operational environments customer services back office tools ticketing solutions and hardware Lot 7c: Systems and Platforms – Transport Network Management: includes: 8a: Active and Passive Infrastructure – Network Devices: includes: delivery, installation, and support of communication devices wired, wireless, and mobile transport communications IoT devices lighting technologies services for lighting infrastructure Lot 8d: Active and Passive Infrastructure – Traffic Management Technologies: includes: permanent and temporary transport management cameras information systems and digital message signs and signals emergency road and tunnel telephones handheld radios Supplier engagement This framework, the second scheme in the Transport Technology
