signals.description: The Welsh Government seeks to appoint a contractor to deliver and further develop a pan-Wales programme of business events industry engagement and lead generation activity over a two-year period. Building on the findings and recommendations of the Mid and West Wales Regional Engagement Pilot, the programme will support the development of stronger regional networks, increased industry collaboration, improved destination readiness and enhanced lead generation activity that aligns with the National Events Strategy for Wales, Tourism strategies and wider Welsh Government priorities. The programme is intended to build long-term industry capability and resilience, enabling stakeholders to take increasing ownership of engagement, collaboration and opportunity development activity beyond the life of the contract. The primary aims and objectives of the contract are to: • Strengthen engagement with business events stakeholders across Wales. • Increase industry awareness and understanding of business events opportunities and support available through Meet In Wales. • Develop stronger regional networks and improve collaboration between destinations, local authorities, venues, hotels and industry partners. • Support destinations and businesses to identify, develop and pursue business events opportunities. • Improve the quality and quantity of lead generation activity across Wales. • Facilitate engagement with key intermediaries including agencies, event organisers, trade organisations and relevant industry bodies. • Identify barriers to growth and provide recommendations to support the development of Wales' business events offer. • Create mechanisms for sharing market intelligence, opportunities, best practice and industry updates. • Support the North Wales educational project by encouraging relevant industry representatives from across Wales to attend, engage fully in the sessions, take learning from the programme and apply this throughout the lifetime of the project. • Ensure opportunities to engage industry are fully utilised, including encouraging businesses to meet current Visit Wales accreditation requirements, secure an appropriate product listing, and explore opportunities to be bookable online through the TXGB distribution channel where relevant. • Support the development of a sustainable pipeline of business events opportunities that can deliver economic and wider benefits to Wales. • Provide measurable outcomes, regular updates and reporting and recommendations that support future business events policy and industry development activity. • Build industry capability, knowledge and confidence to support a sustainable and increasingly industry-led approach to business events engagement and opportunity development across Wales. • Develop and implement a clear transition and exit plan that enables industry stakeholders to assume greater ownership of networks, engagement activity, intelligence sharing and opportunity development by the end of the contract period. signals.description: Patentti- ja rekisterihallitus (jäljempänä PRH) on käynnistänyt hankinnan valmistelun, jonka kohteena on alustavan suunnitelman mukaan WordPress-julkaisujärjestelmällä toteutettava uusi prh.fi-verkkosivusto. Hankintaan kuuluu sivuston tekninen toteutus valmiiden suunnitelmien pohjalta sekä jatkuvat tuki-, ylläpito-, ja kehittämispalvelut. Hankinnan tavoitteena on toteuttaa moderni, luotettava ja helposti ylläpidettävä verkkosivusto, joka ohjaa asiakkaiden toimintaa ja asiointia sekä toimii Patentti- ja rekisterihallituksen pääviestintäkanavana. Tavoitteena on laadukas käyttäjäkokemus, palvelun jatkuva toimivuus sekä verkkosivuston kehittäminen myös tulevaisuudessa. Tämän markkinakartoitusilmoituksen tarkoituksena on käynnistää markkinavuoropuhelu kutsumalla hankinnasta kiinnostuneet yritykset ilmoittautumaan markkinavuoropuheluun. MARKKINAVUOROPUHELU Markkinavuoropuhelu on tarkoitettu hankinnasta kiinnostuneille yrityksille. Markkinavuoropuhelussa yrityksille varataan mahdollisuus kommentoida hankintaan liittyviä luonnosmateriaaleja kirjallisesti. Luonnosmateriaalien kommentointimahdollisuuksia on alustavasti suunniteltu järjestettäväksi vuoden 2026 aikana. Hankintayksikkö voi myös kutsua tarvittaessa hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä kahdenvälisiin tapaamisiin. Mahdolliset tapaamiset järjestetään Teamsin välityksellä. ILMOITTAUTUMINEN Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita yrityksiä pyydetään ilmoittamaan viimeistään 1.10.2026 yhteystietonsa sähköpostitse osoitteeseen kilpailutus@hansel.fi ja otsikoimaan sähköpostiviesti "PRH / verkkosivuston toteutus ja ylläpito". MUUTA HUOMIOITAVAA Huomioittehan, että kyseessä on markkinakartoitusilmoitus, eikä tällä ilmoituksella pyydetä osallistumishakemuksia tai tarjouksia. Tässä ilmoituksessa esitetyt tiedot ovat alustavia ja saattavat muuttua hankinnan valmistelun edetessä. Markkinavuoropuheluun osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei estä mahdolliseen hankintamenettelyyn osallistumista. Hankintayksikkö ei maksa korvausta markkinavuoropuheluun osallistumisesta. Ilmoittautuneiden henkilöiden henkilötietoja käytetään vain tämän hankinnan valmisteluun liittyviin yhteydenottoihin. Hansel Oy toimii tässä hankinnassa konsultoivassa roolissa.

signals.description: The objective of this procurement is to establish a multi-supplier framework agreement for the provision of software development expertise for the entire VR Group. Experts are assigned to VR’s agile development teams, who operate according to VR’s technology choices and established models where VR acts as the Product Owner and oversees overall project and development management. The maximum value also includes possible option periods of the procurement. VR Group does not commit to any minimum purchase volumes. Actual resource needs may increase or decrease during the contract period based on business requirements, technological development, and the lifecycle of projects and systems. The initial contract period is two (2) years, after which the Customer may extend the Agreement with four (4) optional periods of one (1) year each. This procurement will be carried out using an open procedure. The Finnish Act on Procurements and Concession Contracts of Entities Operating in the Water and Energy Supply, Transport and Postal Services Sector (Act 1398/2016, “Act on Public Contracts in the Utilities Sector”) applies to this procurement. Tenders must meet all suitability requirements set out in this notice and its appendices. The subject of the procurement is described in more detail in Appendix 2 (Procurement Description) to the Invitation to Tender. signals.description: Die Verwaltungsdirektion des WDR beabsichtigt, einen Rahmenvertrag über Beratungs-, Konzeptions- und fachliche Begleitleistungen für das Projekt "Business Warehouse" abzuschließen. Das Vorhaben ist als mehrjähriges Transformations- und Umsetzungsprojekt angelegt. Ziel des Projekts ist die fachliche Konzeption und schrittweise Einführung eines integrierten Steuerungsmodells, das strategische Planung, Mittelallokation, Portfolio- und Performancebetrachtung sowie Transparenz über Ressourcen, Kosten und Wirkung miteinander verknüpft. Das Vorhaben dient damit der Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Steuerungsfähigkeit des WDR. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet das Vorhaben von der Feinkonzeption über die Umsetzungsphase bis zur Produktivsetzung und dem Übergang in den Regelbetrieb. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind ausschließlich Beratungsleistungen, die fachliche Konzeption sowie die fachliche Begleitung des Projekts über alle Projektphasen hinweg. Erwartet wird auch die fachliche Konzeption und Begleitung der technischen Umsetzung sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare Prozess-, Daten- und Systemanforderungen. Die technische Implementierung und Softwareentwicklung selbst sind nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung. Der Auftrag wird als Rahmenvertrag ohne Abnahmeverpflichtung ausgeschrieben. Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt 27 Monate ab Leistungsbeginn; der WDR erhält die Option, den Ver-trag einmalig um ein weiteres Jahr zu verlängern. Die geschätzte Abrufmenge beträgt ca. 350 Personentage; die Höchstmenge beträgt 400 Personentage. Mit Erreichen der Höchstmenge endet die Möglichkeit weiterer Abrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag. Aus der geschätzten Abrufmenge folgt keine Verpflichtung des WDR, Leistungen in diesem Umfang abzurufen.

signals.description: Danmarks Nationalbank (”Nationalbanken”) er Danmarks centralbank. Nationalbankens virksomhed bygger på lov om Danmarks Nationalbank fra 1936, hvorefter Nationalbanken har til opgave at opretholde et sikkert pengevæsen i Danmark samt at lette og regulere pengeomsætning og kreditgivning. Denne opgavebeskrivelse er fortsat dækkende for Nationalbankens rolle og ansvar som centralbank. Nationalbanken varetager en række samfundskritiske opgaver, herunder drift og overvågning af kritisk betalingsinfrastruktur samt udøvelse af centrale pengepolitiske funktioner. De processer, systemer og data, der understøtter disse opgaver, er af afgørende betydning for den finansielle stabilitet og tilliden til det danske finansielle system. Nationalbankens forretningsmæssige behov skal sikre, at kontrakten understøtter et højt niveau af leverancesikkerhed, robusthed og kontinuitet i leveringen af Ydelserne. Leverandøren forventes derfor at udvise en proaktiv tilgang til såvel den daglige leverance som til håndtering af risici, forbedringsmuligheder og teknologisk udvikling. Nationalbanken har et højt fokus på informationssikkerhed, og Leverandøren skal sikre et sikkerhedsniveau, der svarer til det, som findes hos sammenlignelige organisationer med et tilsvarende trusselsbillede. Nationalbankens sikkerhedskrav gælder for alle leverancer og aktiviteter, der udføres for eller på vegne af Nationalbanken som led i leveringen af Kontraktens Ydelser. Dette stiller høje krav til sikkerhed, robusthed og operationel modstandsdygtighed. På den baggrund stilles der krav om, at Leverandøren under hele kontraktperioden skal være certificeret efter ISO/IEC 27001:2022 eller en tilsvarende international standard. Derudover stiller Kontrakten krav om at Leverandøren efterlever SWIFT CSP krav og kan dokumentere denne efterlevelse overfor både Nationalbanken og SWIFT. Nationalbanken anvender som udgangspunkt Microsoft-baserede teknologier og værktøjer i sin IT-arkitektur og systemunderstøttelse. Endvidere baseres Service Delivery Management på ITIL v3-principper og -processer. Kontrakten har til formål at etablere et leverandørsamarbejde om levering af services relateret til it-arbejdspladser, enhedsadministration, Onsitesupport og servicedesk. IT-arbejdspladsen omfatter bl.a. leverance og support af stationære computere, bærbare computere, og periferiudstyr samt servicedesk-funktioner og relaterede drifts- og supportydelser. Derudover support af tablets og smartphones. Nationalbanken har i forbindelse med implementeringen af Windows 11 gennemført en større udskiftning af ældre enheder, hvilket har medført en betydelig modernisering af Nationalbankens PC-portefølje. Der er tale om en high-end PC model, der udleveres til alle medarbejdere og eksterne konsulenter. Leverandøren skal i den forbindelse erhverve ejerskab til visse aktiver (hardware). Leverandøren skal fungere som central kontaktflade (Single Point of Contact) for de omfattede ydelser og indgå i et tæt samarbejde med Nationalbankens interne funktioner, Nationalbankens Service Integrator og øvrige leverandører. Nationalbanken anvender et multileverandør-setup og Leverandøren skal derfor understøtte effektiv integration og samarbejde med øvrige leverandører, herunder relevante service management-processer og værktøjer. Kunden stiller Kundens ITSM-løsning til rådighed for Leverandøren til brug for efterfølgende levering af ydelserne. Leverandøren skal anvende Nationalbankens ITSM-løsning til de processer, sagsregistreringer, vidensartikler, opdateringer og aktiviteter, som Nationalbanken anviser. Ligeledes stiller Nationalbanken en samarbejdsplatform til rådighed for Leverandøren til brug for samarbejdet mellem Nationalbanken og Leverandøren. Leverandøren kan blive mødt med krav om iagttagelse af virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven.

signals.description: Iraq faces a persistent gap between its people and the financial system. Banks have long leaned on large state-owned institutions, credit has flowed mainly to established borrowers, and micro and small businesses along with women entrepreneurs and displaced communities have been largely left out. ProDIGI project, full name Promoting Employment in the Digital and Green Economy in Iraq, is trying to change that in a practical, grounded way. ProDIGI is a multi-donor initiative commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), co-financed by the European Union, and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. The project covers central and southern Iraq as well as the Kurdistan Region, with a focus on areas where joblessness, displacement, and limited access to services overlap. Within the project, Output 3 targets the financial inclusion side of the challenge. The starting point is a clear-eyed look at what the sector lacks: financial service providers that are capable, willing, and equipped to design products that fit the people they are supposed to serve. Banks and microfinance institutions in Iraq today mostly offer standardised products with high collateral requirements and limited digital capabilities. Reaching women led small businesses, rural communities, or young entrepreneurs running green or tech ventures requires a different kind of product, and often a different kind of institution. To bridge that gap, the project works directly with Iraqi financial service providers: banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment companies, fintechs, and government lending programmes. The approach combines needs assessments, hands-on advisory services, staff training, product design support, and pilot testing. The goal is not to deliver a finished product from outside, but to build the knowledge and process capacity within each institution so that change remains after the project ends. By the close of the assignment, at least three new or significantly adapted financial products must be in place, and these products must be actively reaching real users at a minimum of 950 individuals and 50 companies. The work also emphasises gender equality: women-led businesses are a priority target group, and all capacity-building activities must include a meaningful share of women participants. The broader context matters too. Iraq's Central Bank launched the national financial inclusion strategy that encourages digital payments, SME lending, and consumer protection improvements. ProDIGI project aligns directly with those priorities, making it both a practical intervention at the level of individual institutions and a contribution to the country's wider financial sector development. The selected firm will work directly with three to five financial service providers (FSPs) operating in Iraq. These may include commercial banks, microfinance institutions, digital payment providers, fintechs, and government lending schemes. GIZ will have pre-selected up to two FSPs before the contract starts, so work can begin without delay. The remaining FSPs will be selected by the contractor and GIZ jointly, based on agreed criteria. The assignment is structured around three work packages. The first covers the selection and appraisal of partner FSPs. The contractor will conduct an institutional diagnostic for each FSP, reviewing their current product offering, business model, lending processes, digital infrastructure, client outreach capacity, and staff skills. Based on that analysis, a cooperation agreement will be signed with each FSP, along with a detailed work plan laying out what the collaboration will achieve and by when. This phase should be completed within the first three months. The second work package is where the core technical work happens. The contractor will support FSPs in designing or adapting financial products that genuinely respond to the needs of target groups, particularly women-led businesses, rural borrowers, and MSME clients who currently lack access to suitable financing. The process follows a structured product development methodology: from prototype design, through pilot testing, to assessment and refinement, and finally roll-out. Alongside the product work, the contractor will help FSPs develop marketing materials and outreach strategies, adjust internal procedures and manuals, and train front-line staff such as loan officers and branch managers. At least three financial product prototypes must be developed by the fifth to seventh month, piloted by month eight, and formally adopted with updated manuals by month ten. The third work package covers cross-cutting contributions: occasional training inputs for financial sector stakeholders such as the Central Bank of Iraq and sector associations; support for GIZ's monitoring and evaluation activities; and at least three public communication outputs, case studies, blog posts, fact sheets, or similar, documenting the work done with each FSP.

signals.description: Der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister (ZIT-BB) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für die unmittelbare Landesverwaltung Brandenburg zur Bereitstellung von IT-Dienstleistungen. Zu seinem umfangreichen Aufgabenportfolio gehören u.a. die Planung, die Bereitstellung und der Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur sowie die Koordination und die Betreuung sowohl von behördenspezifischen als auch behördenübergreifenden und gemeinsamen IT-Verfahren. In seinen Aufgabenbereich fallen auch das IT-Sicherheitsmanagement für die IT-Infrastruktur der Landesverwaltung und die Zuständigkeit für das Computer-Emergency-Response-Team (CERT). Der ZIT-BB betreut von seinem zentralen Standort Potsdam aus derzeit ca. 18.000 Arbeitsplätze in der Landesverwaltung Brandenburg. Die Anzahl der zu betreuenden Arbeitsplätze wird in den kommenden Jahren weiter ansteigen. Mit der Zentralisierung der IT der Landesverwaltung ist die Unterstützung der Behörden und Einrichtungen des Landes Brandenburg bei der Planung, der Gestaltung und dem Einsatz von Informationstechnik sowie die Beratung in Fragen der IT-Sicherheit zu einem wesentlichen Tätigkeitsfeld des Betriebs geworden. Ferner erbringt der ZIT-BB Leistungen nach dem Brandenburgischen E-Government-Gesetz insbesondere für Gemeinden, Ämter und Gemeindeverbände des Landes. Der Hauptstandort des ZIT-BB befindet sich in der Steinstraße 104-106 in 14480 Potsdam. Aufgrund seiner landesweiten Zuständigkeit hat der ZIT-BB u.a. Außenstandorte in Cottbus, Frankfurt (Oder), Wünsdorf, Gransee und Eberswalde. Sein Rechenzentrum betreibt er in Berlin. Mittels dieser Vergabe soll ein Externer Informationssicherheitsbeauftragter (ISB) für den Brandenburgischen IT-Dienstleister beauftragt werden. Die beschriebenen Leistungen sind sofort nach Zuschlagserteilung zu erbringen und enden spätestens nach Erreichen der unter Ziffer 4.1 festgelegten Obergrenzen im EVB-IT Dienstvertrag. Der Auftraggeber geht von einem Umfang von 700 Personentagen aus. Näheres zum Leistungsgegenstand ist in der Leistungsbeschreibung Teil B geregelt.

signals.description: The International Charter: Space and Major Disasters (“the Charter”) is a global agreement which aims to provide a unified system of space data acquisition and delivery to those affected by natural or man-made disasters. It provides and enables transmission of earth observation satellite data and pre-authorised resilience/emergency response bodies in response to “activations”. Further details on the Charter can be found at https://disasterscharter.org/ Unlike many space faring nations in the Charter, the UK Government does not own or operate its own national EO satellite system assets. The UK Government therefore fulfils its Charter commitments through partnership with the UK EO commercial sector. This procurement seeks to maintain and strengthen that model by securing operational support from an organisation with UK licensed and operated EO satellite data assets that can be contributed to Charter activations. The continued participation of UK EO commercial satellite operators in the Charter delivers both public benefit and strategic value by showcasing sovereign EO capabilities, supporting international disaster response and demonstrating operational utility of UK-developed EO missions. The Contracting Authority is intending to launch this requirement by the 9th of October - prospective bidders should note it may launch earlier at the Contracting Authority's discretion: all dates provided are estimates at this stage. Lot 1: Dental Consumables & Appliances. This Lot provides dental consumables and appliance-based solutions designed to support the delivery of routine and specialist dental care across primary, community, and secondary care settings. These products include single use and repeat use materials, small appliances, and consumable items required for preventive dentistry, restorative procedures, orthodontics, minor oral surgery, anaesthesia, and infection control. The scope includes consumables and all associated accessories, where applicable, required to support safe, effective, and compliant dental treatment. Lot 2: Specialist Clinical & Bespoke Solutions. This Lot covers specialist clinical systems, implantology and orthodontic products, as well as bespoke dental laboratory appliances and restorations manufactured to individual patient requirements. It covers powered systems, procedure kits and software enabled treatment solutions that support diagnosis, planning and delivery of specialist dental care. The scope includes devices and all associated equipment, accessories, consumables (where part of a system), maintenance, software, technical support and training. Additionally, it covers the provision of patient specific and bespoke restorations. Lot 3: Operatory Equipment. This Lot provides dental operatory equipment used for routine chairside patient care within dental treatment environments. It includes dental treatment units, delivery systems, operating lights, handpieces, micromotors, ultrasonic scaling systems, mobile treatment carts and associated operatory infrastructure, including suction systems and compressors. This Lot excludes specialist clinical systems used within defined endodontic, implantology, orthodontic and oral surgery workflows, which fall within the scope of Lot 2 – Specialist Clinical & Bespoke Solutions. Lot 4: Dental Laboratory & Digital Solutions. This Lot provides digital dentistry and laboratory solutions spanning the design, manufacture and finishing of dental restorations and appliances, and supports associated digital workflows. It includes CAD/CAM systems, scanners, milling units, 3D printers, sintering furnaces, laboratory equipment and materials. The scope includes equipment and all associated accessories, installation, maintenance, software, technical support, training and, where applicable, validated workflows. Lot 5: Dental Imaging & Diagnostics. This Lot includes both ionising imaging systems (e.g. X-ray, CBCT) and non-ionising diagnostic imaging devices (e.g. intraoral cameras and scanners). It includes intraoral x-ray units, OPG/cephalometric systems, CBCT, digital sensors/PSP systems, intraoral cameras and diagnostic imaging software. The scope includes devices and all associated equipment, accessories, installation, acceptance testing, maintenance, software, technical support, integration and training. Lot 6: Dental Environment, Decontamination & Practice Building. This Lot provides environmental, furniture and fit-out solutions for dental surgeries and decontamination areas. It includes clinical cabinetry and furniture, ergonomic surgery design/refurbishment, decontamination room furniture and workflow systems, and supporting clinical infrastructure components associated with dental environments. The scope includes supply, installation, and, where applicable, design support, project services, maintenance and training. Lot 7: Mobile Dental Clinics & Equipment. This Lot provides mobile dental treatment environments and portable operatory solutions designed to deliver care outside fixed clinical premises. It includes mobile dental vans, trailers and self-contained pods, as well as portable dental chairs/units and field dentistry kits. The scope includes units and associated equipment, installation/commissioning (where applicable), accessories, maintenance, technical support, training and documentation.

signals.description: The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is undertaking a virtual market engagement exercise Wednesday 5th August 2026 @ 10am , via MS Teams, to inform the commissioning of the Online Harms Digital Youth Work Pilot Programme. The London Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is committed to understanding the factors that place children and young people at risk of violence, exploitation and harm, and to working collaboratively with partners to deliver long-term, sustainable solutions. We work across communities and sectors, including youth services, local government, education, health, policing and the voluntary and community sector, championing a public health approach that combines prevention, early intervention and effective support for those experiencing the greatest levels of risk and vulnerability. At the heart of our approach is the belief that violence is preventable, not inevitable. We recognise, however, that many children and young people are already navigating the impacts of trauma, exploitation, abuse and complex community dynamics. As such, our work seeks not only to prevent harm before it occurs, but also to strengthen the systems, services and trusted adults responsible for safeguarding, supporting and intervening with those most affected. Central to this approach is a commitment to partnership working, evidence-informed practice and ensuring that the voices, experiences and expertise of young people and communities shape the solutions designed to support them. The Mayor's Violence Reduction Unit (VRU) is seeking to engage with the market in advance of a forthcoming procurement opportunity relating to the delivery of its flagship Digital Youth Work Pilot Programme. The programme forms part of the VRU's wider public health approach to violence reduction and sits within a London-wide model developed following extensive consultation with young people, practitioners, safeguarding professionals, academics and sector experts. Digital life brings clear benefits for many children. Ofcom found that 99% of 13–17-year-olds see at least one benefit to being online, including help with schoolwork, learning new skills and maintaining social connections. 93% of children in the UK play video games, and children report that gaming helps them socialise with friends, learn new skills and have fun, with most online interactions taking place with friends they already know offline. At the same time, the VRU is concerned that these same digital environments expose children and young people to a wide range of harms and risks. Digital safety is increasingly a public safety and public health concern. Children and young people are navigating identity, relationships, influence, exploitation and conflict across interconnected online and offline environments. However, systems, services and safeguarding responses have often struggled to keep pace with the rapidly evolving nature of digital spaces. This matters for the VRU because online harms do not sit separately from wider concerns about violence, vulnerability, exploitation and safeguarding. The VRU is seeking delivery partners to pilot innovative Digital Youth Work (DYW) approaches across London that drive new models of engagement with young people and promote safeguarding in digital spaces. The VRU is seeking approaches that: Design, deliver and test new or existing digital youth work models Extend trusted, relationship-based youth work into digital environments Strengthen early intervention, prevention and safeguarding online Generate learning, insight and practical outputs to strengthen future activity The programme aims not only to deliver effective pilot activity, but also to contribute to sector-wide innovation and the development of scalable models of digital youth work across London. Scope of delivery The programme will be structured into three complementary lots: Lot 1: Supporting High-Need and Digitally Dependent Young People Testing approaches that improve accessibility and engagement for young people who face barriers to traditional provision, including SEND. Lot 2: Early Intervention and Prevention of Online Harms Testing models that enable early identification, prevention and response to online risks, with a focus on safeguarding and preventative practice of deterring online to offline violence. Lot 3: Universal Digital Youth Work and Positive Opportunities Exploring how digital youth work can foster connection, creativity, play, participation and digital citizenship for all young people. Bidders may apply for one, two or all three lots. Applications may be submitted by individual organisations or as partnerships/consortia. Target Audience The programme will focus on delivering digital youth work to children and young people aged 11–25 across London, including but not limited to: Young people at higher risk of being impacted by online harms Those facing barriers to traditional youth provision, including SEND and young people who may be more digitally dependent and/or digitally excluded Young people experiencing vulnerability linked to violence, exploitation or disadvantage Young people with caring responsibilities Young people in the care system Young people affected by Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) The wider youth population through universal provision Potential delivery settings and workforces may include, but are not limited to: Community-based youth organisations and youth services Detached, outreach and neighbourhood-based provision Faith and community organisations SEND and disability-focused youth provision Organisations supporting young people experiencing vulnerability, exclusion or barriers to traditional youth provision Specialist services working with young people affected by violence, exploitation or online harms Informal education, mentoring and participation-based youth provision Indicative Outcomes The programme is expected to contribute to: Increased engagement of young people in safe, supportive digital environments Improved accessibility of youth work for young people who do not traditionally engage with youth work and are digitally dependent and/or digitally excluded) Strengthened early identification and prevention of online harms in the digital space Increased use of technology to foster positive opportunities Strengthen young people’s digital citizenship Increased workforce confidence and capability in incorporating digital youth work into traditional practice and safeguarding policy Development of scalable models, guidance and practical tools A stronger London-wide evidence base on digital youth work and online safety Timeframe and Budget The maximum estimated budget for this programme is up to £650,000 excl. VAT over a full contract period from November 2026 – March 2029, subject to confirmation of funding, internal governance and relevant approvals. This comprises: £390,000 core funding across the 2026/27 and 2027/28 financial years from November 2026 to March 2028 An extension option of up to £260,000 for a further 12 months from April 2028 The VRU welcomes bids from individual organisations as well as collaborative partnerships and consortia. We recognise that expertise may be distributed across different organisations, and we encourage applications that bring together complementary skills, knowledge and experience. Providers do not need to demonstrate strength across every area independently, provided that the partnership as a whole can evidence the required expertise and capacity to deliver the programme. This may include, for example, combining specialist knowledge in DYW, supporting SEND or neurodiverse children, digital safety, contextual safeguarding, fostering positive digital opportunities, and preventative violence reduction approaches. Market Engagement / Response The VRU welcomes engagement from organisations with expertise in: Youth work and youth engagement Digital youth work Gaming, AI, technology Safeguarding and contextual safeguarding Online harms, exploitation and violence prevention Working with vulnerable and hard-to-reach young people Youth participation and co-production Learning, evaluation and evidence generation If you are interested in the opportunity and meet the core capabilities as set out above, then please join us for our early market warming event on Wednesday 5th August 2026 at 10:00AM. Attending the early market warming session does not constitute a commitment to participate in any future procurement process. The Eventbrite link for market warming session can be found here - https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/london-vru-online-harms-digital-youth-work-pilot-market-warming-session-tickets-1994744836503?aff=oddtdtcreator Please note that this exercise is in no way a call for competition and will not result in the award of a contract to any respondents to this notice. If have any further questions about this opportunity, please contact: vruprocurement@london.gov.uk For more information about this opportunity, please visit the eSourcing portal at: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/tenders/UK-UK-London:-Digital-mapping-services./5SJUMP2G3Z To respond to this opportunity, please click here: https://www.delta-esourcing.com/respond/5SJUMP2G3Z Lot 1: Supporting high-need and digitally dependent young people. Test and develop Digital Youth Work approaches that improve accessibility, inclusion and engagement for young people who face barriers to traditional provision, particularly those with SEND, neurodiverse needs or higher levels of digital dependency. Lot 2: Early intervention and prevention of online harms. Test Digital Youth Work approaches that strengthen early identification, prevention and safeguarding responses to online harms, vulnerabilities and online-to-offline risks. Lot 3: Universal digital youth work and positive opportunities. Explore how Digital Youth Work can foster connection, belonging, creativity, participation and positive opportunities for children and young people through universal and strengths-based approaches.

signals.buyer_name: Ministerium für Bildung, Jugend und Sport des Landes Brandenburg
signals.description: Es soll ein Beobachtungsinstrument der sprachlichen und mathematischen Entwicklung von Kindern entwickelt, pilotiert, validiert und auf Reliabilität geprüft werden, das sich aus dem Bildungsplan Brandenburg ableitet. Die Items zur Kompetenzerfassung von Kindern am Ende der Kita-Zeit (3. Drittel des letzten Kita-Jahres) werden als "Individuelle Lernstandsanalyse am Übergang Kita-Schule (ILeA 0)" konzipiert und an das bereits vorhandene Beobachtungsinstrument für die "Individuelle Lernstandsanalyse in den ersten 6 Wochen nach dem Schuleintritt (ILeA plus)" anschlussfähig ausgestaltet. Ziel ist ein integriertes, strukturell harmonisiertes Beobachtungssystem, das die sprachliche und mathematische Entwicklung in vergleichbarer und anschlussfähiger Struktur erfasst. Lot LOT-0001: Entwicklung, Pilotierung, Validierung und Reliabilitätsprüfung eines Beobachtungsinstruments der sprachlichen und mathematischen Entwicklung. Der Auftraggeber erwartet ein standardisiertes, wissenschaftlich fundiertes, schlankes und praxisorientiertes Beobachtungsinstrument. Für den Auftraggeber ist ein einheitlicher konzeptioneller Ansatz von zentraler Bedeutung, um den Qualifizierungsbedarf in der Praxis gering zu halten sowie die Nutzung durch die pädagogischen Fachkräfte mit der einheitlichen Struktur von ILeA 0 zu vereinfachen. Die Leistung ist aufgeteilt in vier Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1 (Entwicklung der sprachlichen Aspekte des Beobachtungsinstruments), Arbeitspaket 2 (Entwicklung der mathematischen Aspekte des Beobachtungsinstrumentes), Arbeitspaket 3 (Erstellen einer Handreichung zum Beobachtungsinstrument), Arbeitspaket 4 (Pilotierung, Validierung und Reliabilitätsprüfung des entwickelten Beobachtungsinstruments). Näheres ist der Anlage 12 (Leistungsbeschreibung) zu entnehmen.

signals.description: Das Angebot der Mitarbeiterberatung für die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Stadt Koblenz umfasst ein Beratungsangebot in Bezug auf die nachgenannten Beratungsanlässe unter 1.3.1 und die erweiterten Leistungen unter 1.3.2. Lot LOT-0001: Stadtverwaltung Koblenz_Bereitstellung Mitarbeiterberatung/Gesundheitsmanagement. 1.3.1 Die nachgenannten Leistungen beziehen sich auf folgende Beratungsanlässe: - Konfliktidentifikation - Belastungssituationen (Arbeitsplatz, persönliche) - Psychische und psychosomatische Probleme - Suchtmittelprobleme und Abhängigkeit - Krisenbewältigung nach Extremerfahrungen (z.B. Tod, Suizid, Unfall, gewalttätige Übergriffe im beruflichen Umfeld) - Notfallsituationen, insbesondere bei Gefahr für Leib und Leben - Beratung von Führungskräften des AG im Umgang mit Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern die gesundheitlich auffällig geworden sind - Facharztvermittlung und Terminservice 1.3.2. Darüber hinaus bezieht sich die erweiterte Leistung des AN auf: - Mitarbeit im Betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement: Die vom AN zu erbringende Leistung umfasst eine aktive Mitarbeit im Rahmen des betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagements und die damit verbundene Teilnahme an entsprechenden Arbeitsgruppen. Die vertragliche Leistung umfasst die Teilnahme von 4 Stunden pro Kalenderjahr. Darüberhinausgehender vom AG diesbezüglich geforderter Unterstützungsbedarf wird mit einem im Rahmen der Nebenleistung festgelegten Stundensatz vom AN gesondert in Rechnung gestellt. - Erstellung jährlicher Berichte zur Schilderung des Umfangs und Anlässe der Beratungen sowie Empfehlungen für das betriebliche Gesundheitsmanagement und die Dienststellenleitung: Es wird jährlich - jeweils zum 02.01. - vonseiten des AN eine aussagekräftige Dokumentation erstellt und unaufgefordert dem AG vorgelegt. Diese enthält den tatsächlichen Umfang der Inanspruchnahme - insbesondere Anzahl der Kontakte telefonisch und persönlich - sowie anonymisierte Inhalte der Beratungsleistung einschließlich einer Spezifizierung der gesundheitlichen Problemstellungen. Ferner wird eine fachlich fundierte Einschätzung der Auswertung erwartet. Darüber hinaus eine Empfehlung zur Entwicklung von Handlungsstrategien auf der Verhaltens- und Verhältnisebene. Dies wird in einem persönlichen Bilanzierungsgespräch auf der Ebene der Dienststellenleitung mit einem zeitlichen Umfang von 2 Zeitstunden umfassend erläutert. - Unterstützung bei Bekanntmachung der externen Mitarbeiterberatung und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Die Beratungsstelle unterstützt aktiv den Prozess der internen Kommunikation zur Mitarbeiterberatung. Hierzu zählt insbesondere die Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung einer innerbetrieblichen Informationsbroschüre sowie Begleitung von Infoständen/Präsentation bei Veranstaltungen (Gesundheitsaktionen, Personalversammlung o.ä). Ferner wird erwartet, dass der AN Veröffentlichungen (beispielsweise auf der Intranetseite) mit Fachbeiträgen unterstützt. - Unabhängig von der anlassbezogenen Beratung wird eine telefonische Unterstützung hinsichtlich dringend notwendiger Terminvereinbarungen bzw. Vermittlung bei/zu Fachärzten und psychologischen Psychotherapeuten auf Anfrage gewünscht. - Es wird zugesichert, dass im Rahmen der geltenden Öffnungszeiten ein aussagefähiger Drogencheck über Urin und Atemluftkontrolle erfolgen kann. Diese Leistung wird im Einzelfall gesondert beauftragt und gesondert abgerechnet. - Es wird seitens des AG gewünscht, dass die Beantragung einer Reha auf Anfrage oder im Rahmen eines bestehenden Beratungsprozesses im psychosomatischen Kontext geleistet wird. Die Abrechnung erfolgt unmittelbar mit dem Antragsteller. - Es wird gewünscht, dass im Rahmen der Fallberatung eine notwendige Zusammenarbeit mit dem AG sowie externen Fachstellen (z.B. Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten, Reha-Einrichtungen) erfolgt. - Kooperationen mit Therapiepraxen, Kliniken, Fachdiensten und Reha-Einrichtungen werden begrüßt. Falls solche Kooperationen bestehen, sind diese nachzuweisen.

signals.description: Following a competitive procurement undertaken in 2019, a contract was awarded for the provision of the Apperta Foundation's OpenEyes Electronic Patient Record (EPR) solution for the management of ophthalmology services across NHS Wales. Digital Health and Care Wales (DHCW) is now undertaking an informal Preliminary Market Engagement (PME) exercise to better understand current market conditions and supplier capabilities in advance of any potential future procurement activity. This engagement relates solely to the hosting, support, maintenance, and ongoing development of the OpenEyes solution across NHS Wales. The scope includes support for implementations within secondary care ophthalmology departments and community optometric practices. Interested suppliers are invited to complete a Request for Information (RFI) questionnaire, available via the eTenderWales portal: https://etenderwales.bravosolution.co.uk/home.html Completed RFI responses must be submitted through the eTenderWales portal no later than 12:00 noon on 1 October 2026. This exercise is being undertaken for market research purposes only and does not constitute a procurement process, commitment to procure, or invitation to tender. DHCW has not yet determined whether a future procurement will be undertaken. Information gathered through this engagement will be used to inform future decision-making and procurement strategy development. Following review of the RFI responses, DHCW reserves the right to engage with respondents on an individual basis to clarify, verify, or supplement information provided. Lot 1: . None

signals.description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

signals.description: The "Strengthening environmental and social governance in the extractive sector" component, co-financed by FONAREDD from CAFI (Central Africa Forest Initiative) resources and BMZ, will be implemented by GIZ for the Ministry of the Environment and Sustainable Development (MEDD) of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The project is being carried out by the Integrated Economic Development of the Mining Sector Project (DISM II), in partnership with the Congolese Environment Agency (ACE), which is responsible for environmental and social assessments and for monitoring and controlling the implementation of ESMPs at national level. Following a 1st Strategic Environmental and Social Study of the mining sector in the DRC in 2010, and in view of the changing international context, it is planned, in agreement with the donor and partners, to launch Strategic Environmental and Social Studies (SESES) for the key sector of mining and hydrocarbons, in order to analyse the expected positive and negative impacts of their development at national level. This work will make it possible to identify good and bad practices in the provinces affected; and in partnership with the various partners and civil society, to propose recommendations integrating REDD+ standards into the extractive sectors. Finally, best practice guides will also be drawn up, based on the experience gained with dialogue platforms in the extractive sector. Adaptations of the various texts relating to the legal and regulatory provisions linked to the environmental and social governance of the extractive sectors will also be proposed in order to be consistent with REDD+ standards and the principles of the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI). Lot LOT-0001: 10007377-Strategic Environmental and Social Assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector to be carried out in the DRC. An open international call for a tender is published for services to be provided for 12 months, requiring a total of 5 experts, including 2 experts with international experience, respectively head of mission and deputy head of mission, with skills in the environment, strategic studies, and knowledge of the hydrocarbon sector. The team will be backed up on site by 3 experts with national experience with skills in social responsibility and oil and gas sector law and public policy. The services to be provided under this contract include measures for human capacity development and organisational and strategy advice in the following thematic areas: 1. Identifying and increasing attention to potential environmental and social risks, direct and indirect impacts and concerns around the development of the oil and gas sector; 2. Identifying and strengthening environmental and social management approaches and practical tools for the Government to manage sectoral environmental and social governance 3. Identifying and strengthening instruments and approaches that can improve environmental and social accountability, including by increasing the transparency of processes in the oil and gas sector and establishing simple, safe and accessible feedback and/or complaint mechanisms. 4. Support strengthening actors" capacity relevant for the sector to manage environmental and social risks related to the development of the oil and gas sector according to the mitigation hierarchy (avoid, minimise, mitigate and offset). The Contractor is responsible for the performance of the services and the production of the following outputs: 1) Strategic environmental and social assessment (SESA) of the oil and gas sector in the DRC. 2) SWOT analysis and recommendations for the oil and gas sector. 3) Socio-environmental management standards for the DRC. 4) Guide to good environmental and social practices for the DRC 5) Draft implementing legislation for the DRC.

signals.description: Um seinen gesetzlichen Verpflichtungen (§146a AO und KassenSichV) nachzukommen muss das BSI die Schutzprofile BSI-CC-PP-0104 Cryptographic Service Provider (CSP) und BSI-CC-PP-0111 CSPLight (CSPL) aktualisieren. Hierzu sollen im Projekt die genannten Schutzprofile ebenfalls für eine breitere Verwendung im Bereich eID / EUDI-Wallet, 5G und FIDO / Passkeys ertüchtigt werden. Dafür notwendig ist auch die Erarbeitung einer standardisierte Schnittstellenbeschreibung für CSPLight Produkte im zentralen Rechenzentrumsbetrieb, um die Interoperabilität zu erhöhen und Abhängigkeiten zu proprietären Architekturen zu minimieren. Das Projekt gliedert sich in drei separate Lose (Fachlose im Sinne des § 97 Abs. 4 GWB): - Los 1: Anpassung und Aktualisierung des CSP-Schutzprofils und CSPL-Schutzprofils (Update-CSPL) - Los 2: Evaluierung CSP-PP/CSPL-PP (Eval-CSPL) - Los 3: Standardisierte Schnittestellenbeschreibung (API-CSPL) Los 1 beinhaltet die Aktualisierung und Modularisierung der Schutzprofile PP-CSP und PP-CSPL. Daran anknüpfend wird in Los 2 eine Evaluierung der Schutzprofile CSP und CSPL nach EUCC durchgeführt. Abschließend wird in Los 3 eine einheitliche, standardisierte Schnittstellenbeschreibung für den CSP-Light auf Basis des in Los 1 erstellten Schutzprofils erarbeitet. Details sind den Leistungsbeschreibungen (siehe Anlagen) zu entnehmen. Lot LOT-0001: Los 1: „Anpassung und Aktualisierung des CSP-Schutzprofils und CSPL-Schutzprofils (Update-CSPL)“. Ziel in Los 1 ist die Anpassung und Aktualisierung der Schutzprofile PP-CSP und PP-CSPL. Dabei sollen die beiden Schutzprofile zusammengeführt werden und dabei der Multi-Assurance Ansatz verfolgt werden. Das neue Schutzprofil soll modular so gestaltet werden, dass es möglich ist verschiedene Einsatzzwecke zu bedienen und eine breite Anwendung zu ermöglichen. Hierbei soll der Kern des PPs auf die minimale notwendige Funktionalität des CSP(L) beschränkt werden. Alle Funktionalitäten, welche nur für bestimmte Zwecke benötigt werden, sollen in Module ausgelagert werden. Für die einzelnen oben genannten Anwendungsszenarien sollen dedizierte PP-Konfigurationen erarbeitet werden, die jeweils passende Kombinationen von Funktionsmodulen enthalten können. Im Los wird zunächst zusammen mit dem AG ein Konzeptentwurf erarbeitet, anschließend soll die detaillierte Architektur beschrieben werden und in einem weiterer AP liegt der Fokus auf der eigentlichen PP Erstellung. Ziel des Loses ist ein aktualisiertes und modularisiertes Schutzprofil sowie mindestens eine zugehörige PP-Konfiguration für den Anwendungsfall Registrierkassen und eID. Lot LOT-0002: Los 2: „Evaluierung CSP-PP/CSPL-PP (Eval-CSPL)“. Auftragsgegenstand in Los 2 ist die Evaluierung des in Los 1 erstellten Schutzprofils. Ergebnis des Loses 2 sind vollständige Einzelprüfberichte, sodass die vorliegenden Berichte zur Zertifizierung des Schutzprofils und seiner Konfiguration eingereicht werden können und alle formalen Anforderungen erfüllt sind. Lot LOT-0003: Los 3: „Standardisierte Schnittstellenbeschreibung (API-CSPL)". Ziel in Los 3 ist die Erstellung einer einheitlichen, standardisierten Schnittstellenbeschreibung für den CSP, sodass eine herstellerunabhängige Nutzung eines CSP auf einer sicheren Server-Architektur für externe Anwendungen ermöglicht wird. Die Grundlage für die Schnittstellenbeschreibung sollen die aktualisierten und modularisierten Schutzprofile, bzw. das zusammengeführte Schutzprofil aus Los 1 sein sowie die aktuelle BSI TR-CSP2.

Tarjoajalta ei edellytetä valmista oppimissisältöä tai valmista XR-ratkaisua tarjousvaiheessa, vaan ratkaisun lopulliset sisällöt, oppimistavoitteet ja käyttötapaukset täsmennetään yhteiskehittämisessä. 2. Toimituksen sisältö Hankinta käsittää koko kehitysprosessin suunnittelusta ja konseptoinnista lopulliseen toteutukseen. Toimitukseen sisältyvät vähintään: - vaatimus- ja sisältötyöpajat sekä konseptointi ja käsikirjoitus; - kolme yhteiskehittämistyöpajaa; - oppimis- ja demonstraatioaineistojen rakentaminen; - kehitysversioiden toteuttaminen ja iteratiivinen kehittäminen; - käyttäjätestaukset IMMO-tilassa ja palautteen hyödyntäminen; - ratkaisun viimeistely ja käyttöönottoon liittyvät toimenpiteet; - lähdekoodin, muokattavien lähdetiedostojen, dokumentaation ja muiden sovittujen aineistojen luovuttaminen; ja - loppuraportointi ja avoimen julkaisemisen valmistelu. Yhteiskehittämiseen osallistuu matkailualan opiskelijoita, opettajia, yritysten edustajia ja hankkeen asiantuntijoita. Toimittaja vastaa tarvitsemastaan kehitys- ja testiympäristöstä. Sopimusvelvoitteet suoritetaan EU/ETA-alueella. Toimittajalla on oikeus toteuttaa Ratkaisun suunnittelu, sisällöntuotanto, kehittäminen, ohjelmointi, dokumentointi ja muut toteutustyöt tilariippumattomasti valitsemassaan tarkoituksenmukaisessa ja tietoturvalliseen työskentelyyn soveltuvassa sijainnissa. Asiakkaan tiloissa työskentelyä edellytetään vain siltä osin kuin erikseen sovitut tapaamiset, testaukset, hyväksymismenettelyt tai IMMO-hankkeen immersiivisen huonetilan käyttö sitä edellyttävät. Asiakkaalla ei ole velvollisuutta järjestää Toimittajalle työtiloja. 3. Ratkaisun keskeiset vaatimukset Ratkaisun tulee: - olla pelillinen siten, että pelillisyys on ratkaisun keskeinen suunnitteluperiaate; - mahdollistaa käyttäjän aktiivinen toiminta, päätöksenteko tai ongelmanratkaisu sekä palaute käyttäjän valinnoista; - mahdollistaa oppimiskokemuksen suorittaminen useita kertoja vaihtoehtoisilla tavoilla; - tukea yhteistä oppimista, ryhmätyöskentelyä, opettajajohtoista ohjausta ja useiden käyttäjien samanaikaista osallistumista; - sisältää pedagogisesti perusteltu etenemismalli; - mahdollistaa oppimissisältöjen ylläpito, kehittäminen ja laajentaminen; - täyttää Q/A-liitteessä kuvatut IMMO-tilan tekniset vaatimukset; ja - toimia normaalissa käytössä ilman jatkuvaa tai käytönaikaista internet-yhteyttä. Tavoitteena on noin 20–30 minuutin oppimiskokemus. Tarjoaja voi hyödyntää olemassa olevia teknologioita, pelimoottoreita, XR-alustoja ja 360 asteen sisältöjä, jos kokonaisuus täyttää hankinta-asiakirjoissa asetetut vaatimukset. 4. Toteutus ja aikataulu Toimittajan tulee toteuttaa ratkaisu ketterän ja iteratiivisen kehittämisen periaatteiden mukaisesti. Toimittaja osallistuu marraskuussa 2026 järjestettävään aloituspalaveriin sekä marras- ja joulukuussa järjestettäviin ensimmäisiin yhteiskehittämistyöpajoihin. Ratkaisun eri versioita testataan käyttäjien kanssa IMMO-tilassa tammikuusta 2027 alkaen. Toimittaja osallistuu helmikuussa 2027 toteutettavaan väliarviointiin ja viimeistelee ratkaisun käyttäjäpalautteen perusteella. Lopullinen ratkaisu sisältöineen on toimitettava ja hyväksytettävä viimeistään 28.2.2027. 5. Hinta ja keskeiset sopimusehdot Hankinnan kiinteä kokonaishinta on 35 000 euroa ilman arvonlisäveroa. Hinta sisältää kaikki hankintasopimuksen ja sen liitteiden mukaisten velvoitteiden täyttämisestä aiheutuvat kustannukset. Toimittaja voi laskuttaa hinnan vasta, kun Asiakas on kirjallisesti hyväksynyt lopullisen toimituksen. Toimitukselle annetaan kuuden kuukauden takuu. Toimittajan vastuulla olevasta viivästyksestä voidaan periä sopimuksessa määritelty viivästyssakko. Ratkaisuun sisältyvään tilaajan sovellukseen ja sen dokumentaatioon sovelletaan lähtökohtaisesti EUPL 1.2 -lisenssiä tai muuta etukäteen hyväksyttyä yhteensopivaa avoimen lähdekoodin lisenssiä. Oppimateriaalien oikeudet, käyttö, muokkaaminen, jakaminen ja mahdollinen avoin julkaiseminen ratkaistaan aineistokohtaisesti. Tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjoukseensa alustava Oppimateriaalien oikeus- ja julkaisuluettelo sekä täydentää sitä projektin aikana. Hankkeen tuotosta ei saa julkaista ilman Asiakkaan kirjallista hyväksyntää. Hankintasopimukseen sovelletaan sopimusluonnosta, JIT 2025 Tilaajan sovellukset avoin lähdekoodi -erityisehtoja ja JIT 2025 Yleisiä ehtoja sopimuksessa määrätyssä soveltamisjärjestyksessä. Tarkemmat vähimmäisvaatimukset, tekniset vaatimukset, hyväksymisedellytykset, vastuut ja muut sopimusehdot määräytyvät tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden perusteella.

signals.description: Synchronicity Care Limited on behalf of Fresh and Balance are seeking a provider of PR Agency Services. Fresh and Balance is the North East's integrated programme for reducing tobacco and alcohol harm in the region. They are one single joint programme carrying out much of the public and partner facing work under the two separate, well recognised brands of Fresh and Balance. Fresh and Balance remit is to reduce smoking rates and the harm caused by tobacco and alcohol amongst the local population and key audiences using a multi-strand approach based on best national and international evidence. This includes mass media campaigns, campaigning and advocacy, effective internal communications, and making voices heard on the national stage to politicians and decision makers. A key element of their work and priority of local funders is the delivery of all year round news and social media reach/engagement to ensure issues and messages in the public eye all year round on the channels that people see, read and hear, providing a highly cost effective return on investment. This also involves working with a range of senior stakeholders for messengers and champions, building support for measures to reduce smoking and harmful drinking, motivating and triggering behaviour change, and engaging and motivating key partners to prioritise these agendas regionally and nationally. Communications cover three main strands: • Behaviour change - highlighting the risks and signposting positive behaviour change around quitting smoking, reducing second hand smoke and reducing drinking - via campaigns, socials and two key websites FreshQuit.co.uk and ReduceMyRisk.tv. • Highlighting the harm - the cost of tobacco and alcohol across the region and nationally to motivate regional stakeholders and the public • Campaigning for change - a strong policy focus to call for more action nationally on tobacco and alcohol, increasing public and partner support for this. This also includes an increasing focus on building partnerships across the health system, local communities and community and voluntary sector. Fresh and Balance are looking for a PR agency with the experience, skills and knowledge to develop communications across the increasing range of available media channels to secure content - both traditional and online. Since we are a joint programme, this will be one contract serving both campaign brands, while still requiring the insight and experience in social marketing approaches to plan campaigns and approaches around both tobacco and alcohol. The successful agency will be expected to provide PR support to support the programme from 1st April 2027 with the potential for contract extensions and subject to satisfactory performance and reviews and funding. signals.description: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) intends to issue a single-source cooperative agreement award to the University of California, Santa Cruz. The award will renew the Data Resource and Administrative Coordination Center (DRACC), a component of the Scalable and Systematic Neurobiology of Psychiatric and Neurodevelopmental Disorder Risk Genes (SSPsyGene) Consortium. The long-term goal of SSPsyGene is to systematically study how risk genes for neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders (NPDs) affect molecular, cellular, circuit, systems/organismal biology. The renewed DRACC will refine its focus on developing a sustainable knowledge base, with shared terms, definitions, and data standards that are interoperable with other knowledge platforms and will enable the use of artificial intelligence to accelerate research on brain function and NPDs. This resource will be made available for broad use by the biomedical community. Projects that propose to build on the DRACC's current role in refining methods and standards to harmonize data from the SSPsyGene Assay and Data Generation Centers and facilitate submission to data archives are encouraged. This is a forecast for a single source NOFO that will invite application(s) from eligible organization(s) to apply. Please see Section III. Eligibility for additional information. In accordance with NIH standard peer-review processes, the application(s) will be peer-reviewed, and only meritorious application(s) will be considered for funding.

signals.description: Der Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung umfasst die Beschaffung einer SaaS-Lösung, welche verschiedene Funktionen und Leistungen umfasst. Dabei liegt der Schwerpunkt auf der Bereitstellung einer umfangreichen digitalen Kommunikationslösung auf Basis von OX 8. Das MBJS sucht nach einem erfahrenen Auftragnehmer, der in der Lage ist, eine entsprechende Lösung auf Basis von OX 8 bereitzustellen und dabei die spezifischen Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse einer Landeslösung für das Land Brandenburg in punkto hohe Sicherheitsstandards (BSI Grundschutz), Datenschutzkonformität (DSGVO), Integrität, Flexibilität und Skalierbarkeit zu erfüllen. Lot LOT-0001: Kommunikationslösung für 25.000 Personen im Bildungsbereich (Lehrermail). Im Jahr 2019 wurde im Auftrag des Ministeriums für Bildung, Jugend und Sport (im Folgenden MBJS genannt) auf Basis der Produkte Univention UCS und Univention UCS@School eine komplexe IT-Infrastruktur aufgebaut, bestehend aus einem zentralen Identitätsmanagement-System, im Folgenden als IDM bezeichnet, und der Groupware- und E-Mail-Lösung Open Xchange vom gleichnamigen Hersteller, im Folgenden als OX bezeichnet. Es wurde eine umfangreiche Kommunikationslösung für 20.000 Lehrkräfte an Schulen in öffentlicher Trägerschaft im Land Brandenburg geschaffen. Die in UCS und UCS@School abgebildeten Schulen in Form von separaten Schul-OUs bilden die Grundlage für die in OX eingerichteten Contexte. Jede Schule ist somit einem separatem Context in OX zugewiesen. Das Anlegen, Ändern und Löschen von Accounts im IDM, erfolgt über die vom MBJS entwickelten Fachverfahren. Nach mehreren Jahren des Betriebs, ist es aufgrund des Lifecycles von OX erforderlich, dass auf die aktuelle Version 8 gewechselt werden muss. Mit dem Wechsel auf OX 8 bedarf es einer umfangreichen Änderungen am UCS OX Connector und an der IT-Infrastruktur. Die Version OX 8 setzt Docker-Laufzeitumgebungen voraus, die mit der bestehenden IT-Infrastruktur nicht gegeben sind. Es ist nicht möglich die Software im bestehenden System einfach zu aktualisieren. Das MBJS beabsichtigt deshalb die Groupware- und E-Mail-Lösung für Lehrkräfte auf Basis von OX zukünftig als SaaS-Lösung durch einen Anbieter betreiben zulassen. Dabei sollen die Nutzerkonten im vorhandenen IDM weiterhin die Grundlage für die E-Mail-Postfächer bilden und die bestehenden Prozesse zur Provisionierung beibehalten werden. Es soll lediglich der Mail-Stack der vorhandenen IT-Infrastruktur durch eine SaaS-Lösung ersetzt werden.

signals.description: The project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" is implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). It supports the Government of Togo in advancing decentralisation and territorial development in the regions of Kara and Savanes. Despite progress in decentralisation, regional and local authorities face persistent challenges in exercising transferred competences, delivering quality public services, mobilising local revenues and promoting inclusive local economic development. These constraints are compounded by poverty, climate change, demographic pressure and a fragile security context in northern Togo. The overall objective is to enable regional and local actors to harness the social and economic potential of their territories to improve living conditions in an equitable and sustainable manner. The project applies an integrated territorial development approach with capacity development at individual, organisational and institutional levels. It cooperates with national ministries (Ministry of Local Development, Ministry of Decentralisation, Ministry of Finance), regional councils and municipalities, the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (Agence nationale de formation des collectivités territoriales, ANFCT), the National Association of Municipalities (Faîtière des Communes du Togo, FCT), civil society organisations and private sector actors. To sustain decentralisation and territorialisation efforts, the project also aims at strengthening socio-economic resilience, in particular of communities in the Northen border regions, and provide economic perspectives, in particular for young people. Activities are structured around three complementary outputs: (1) Strengthening the capacities of regional and local authorities to implement transferred competences. (2) Improving collaboration between public institutions, local authorities, civil society and the private sector for inclusive and conflict-sensitive territorial development. (3) Strengthening transparent, participatory and accountable local public financial management. Innovative elements include municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning, digital solutions for local governance, performance-based management and evidence-based decision-making. Gender equality, social inclusion (LNOB), climate resilience, conflict sensitivity and digitalisation are mainstreamed across all interventions to ensure sustainable and scalable results. The assignment targets 38 municipalities in Kara and Savanes through FCT and ANFCT, with a view to progressive replication towards all 117 municipalities. Benchmarking and peer learning will be designed, piloted and institutionalised to steer capacity development and foster continuous improvement. In addition, specialised technical assistance will complement these mechanisms across the three outputs, including support for implementing transferred competences, facilitating inclusive territorial collaboration and strengthening local public financial management (e. g. participatory budgeting, revenue mobilisation, transparency and anti-corruption), while ensuring digital solutions adhere to recognised standards and are interoperable with national ecosystems. Lot LOT-0001: 10030260-Appui à la valorisation des potentiels territoriaux pour un développement local inclusif dans le nord du Togo. The objective of the assignment is to provide comprehensive technical assistance supporting the implementation of the project "Integrated Territorial Development and Good Governance in Togo" through institutional development, digital transformation, municipal benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning and specialised technical expertise contributing to integrated territorial development and good local governance in northern Togo. GIZ seeks to contract a consultancy firm for an implementation period of 24 months. The contractor will provide technical services through two Key Experts and a pool of short-term experts with international, regional and national experience allowing demand-driven mobilisation of specialised expertise throughout project implementation. The overall contract is expected to require approximately 1.500 expert days, delivered through individual experts and expert pools. The assignment is organised around four complementary work packages: Work Package 1: Development and institutionalisation of municipal benchmarking The contractor will support the development and implementation of a harmonised benchmarking system for municipalities, including performance frameworks, indicators, data collection methodologies, digital data management solutions and institutional anchoring in close collaboration within the National Association of Municipalities of Togo (FCT). The performance assessment on key competences of municipalities through the benchmarking system will provide the basis for mutual learning by identifying individual strengths and weaknesses across municipalities. Work Package 2: Development and institutionalisation of peer-to-peer learning The contractor will support the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (ANFCT) in establishing sustainable peer-to-peer learning mechanisms based on the benchmarking results, including learning methodologies, training concepts, organisational arrangements and knowledge management. Work Package 3: Operational implementation The contractor will support the implementation of benchmarking and peer-to-peer learning in the target municipalities through data collection and analysis, facilitation of learning events, capacity development, capitalisation of experiences and gradual institutionalisation of the developed mechanisms. Work Package 4: Provision of specialised short-term expertise The contractor will provide a pool of international, regional and national experts covering organisational development, digital solutions, benchmarking, peer-to-peer learning, monitoring and evaluation, territorial development, decentralisation, local economic development, public financial management and other specialised expertise required during project implementation. The contractor will be responsible for providing strategic and technical advisory services, conducting analyses and studies, developing methodologies and digital tools, facilitating multi-stakeholder processes, organising workshops, trainings and study visits, supporting institutional development and delivering monitoring and evaluation activities where required. The contractor will work closely with GIZ, the Ministry of Local Development (MDDL), regional authorities, municipalities, the National Association of Municipalities (FCT), the National Training Agency for Local Authorities (ANFCT) and other public and private stakeholders. Close coordination with other development partners active in northern Togo is expected where relevant. Throughout the implementation period, the contractor shall ensure high-quality technical delivery, regular reporting, knowledge management and quality assurance. Innovative, scalable and context-adapted approaches are expected in order to strengthen institutional ownership, facilitate replication and contribute to the long-term sustainability of the mechanisms developed under the project.

signals.description: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Beschaffung und Implementierung einer Extended Detection & Response (XDR)‐Lösung, mit dem Ziel, die IT‐Sicherheit durch moderne Erkennungs‐ und Reaktionsmechanismen signifikant zu erhöhen und insbesondere fortschrittliche Bedrohungen frühzeitig zu identifizieren sowie effektiv zu behandeln. Lot LOT-0001: Extended Detection & Response (XDR) – Lösung. Das Klinikum Esslingen betreibt eine umfangreiche IT‐Infrastruktur mit zahlreichen IT‐Endpunkten, darunter PCs, Thin Clients und Server. Ergänzend bestehen vernetzte Medizinprodukte (IoMT) sowie Systeme der Gebäudeleittechnik (GLT), die jedoch nicht Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind. Die derzeit eingesetzte Endpoint‐Security basiert auf einer signaturbasierten Basislösung (Sophos), die keine erweiterten Funktionen wie Verhaltensanalyse oder Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) bereitstellt. Das Projekt verfolgt folgende strategische und operative Ziele: • Ablösung der bestehenden signaturbasierten Endpoint-Security durch eine XDR-Lösung mit Verhaltensanalyse, Machine Learning und forensischer Analysefähigkeit gemäß dem Stand der Technik • Herstellung vollständiger Endpoint-Sichtbarkeit und -Kontrolle für alle IT-Endpunkte (Clients und Server) des Klinikums Esslingen • Aktivierung von Sophos Synchronized Security: Echtzeit-Kommunikation zwischen Endpoint-Agents und der bestehenden Sophos XGS Firewall zur automatisierten Netzwerkisolierung kompromittierter Endpunkte • Schaffung forensischer Analysefähigkeiten: kontinuierliches Endpoint-Telemetrie-Recording, Root-Cause-Analyse und Threat Hunting über alle Endpunkte hinweg • Aktivierung der Cross-Domain-Korrelation (XDR): Verknüpfung von Endpoint-Events mit Firewall-, E-Mail-, Cloud- und Identity-Datenquellen sowie Vorbereitung der MDR-Service-Anbindung • Erfüllung der regulatorischen Anforderungen aus NIS-2 und DSGVO hinsichtlich Endpoint-Security sowie Orientierung am Stand der Technik (B3S Gesundheit) • Unterstützung des Schwachstellenmanagements durch Endpoint-basierte Vulnerability-Sichtbarkeit

signals.description: By & Havn står over for at skulle transformere Levantkaj i Nordhavn fra en eksisterende containerterminal til et moderne bykvarter. Med det nuværende lokalplanforslag forventes det, at der vil kunne etableres ca. 350.000 etagemeter boliger, serviceerhverv og offentlige funktioner samt ca. 50.000 etagemeter parkering fordelt på to parkeringshuse på Levantkaj. Lokalplanen vil også muliggøre anlæg af en metrohøjbane, en ny metrostation samt gang- og cykelforbindelser, der kobles sammen med de overordnede forbindelser i Nordhavn. Lokalplanforslaget vil fastlægge området til et blandet bolig- og erhvervsområde med karakter af boligområde med en forventet fordeling på bolig og erhverv på 75/25 med tilhørende faciliteter som skole og fodboldbane, dag-institutioner, kirke, halkompleks for sport, plejecenter mv. Lokalplanforslaget forventes politisk godkendt i Q4 2026, og den endelige lokalplan forventes vedtaget i Q3 2027. By & Havn vil være ansvarlig for anlægsarbejder, etablering af p-huse samt salg af byggeretter, og By & Havn har en ambition om, at alle byområder DGNB-certificeres til minimum Platin. I forbindelse med By & Havns kommende salg af byggeretter, ønsker By & Havn med dette udbud at indgå aftale med en rådgiver om økonomisk og kommerciel rådgivning relateret til By & Havns udvikling af primært stueetager indeholdende detail- og publikumsorienterede serviceerhverv på Levantkaj, som By & Havn vil gennemføre i et joint venture med en samarbejdspartner/investor. Rådgiverens ydelse vedrører rådgivning om som udgangspunkt ca. 6.000 – 7.000 m2 detail- og publikumsorienterede funktioner i stueetagerne - hvilket er det areal, som joint venturet skal eje og udleje - og omfatter ikke bistand med salg eller udvikling af øvrige boligbyggeretter eller øvrige ejendomme på Levantkaj. By & Havn overvejer dog muligheden for at udvide joint venture-selskabets opgave med inkludering af dele af erhvervsfelterne. Den udbudte aftale består af to overordnede dele (hovedopgaver), som kan have et tidsmæssigt overlap: • Forretningsplan: Udarbejdelse af en detaljeret forretningsplan til brug for processen vedr. at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor. Forretningsplanen skal beskrive, hvordan et selskab mellem samarbejdspartner/investor og By & Havn skal sammensættes og på et detaljeret niveau beskrive bl.a. likviditet, ejerfordeling, lejeniveau, indfasning af leje og forrentningskrav, mv. • Tilrettelæggelse og gennemførelse af en proces til at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor: Med inspiration fra processen ved By & Havns udvikling af Århusgadekvarteret i Nordhavn, ønsker By & Havn at finde en samarbejdspartner/investor, der kan indgå i et joint venture med By & Havn om at eje stueetager indeholdende detail- og publikumsorienterede serviceerhverv på Levantkaj med henblik på fælles udleje. Samarbejdspartneren/investoren skal være den aktive part i at lokalisere de rette lejere til disse stueetager. Rådgiveren skal bistå med at tilrettelægge og gennemføre en proces med at finde den rette samarbejdspartner/investor, herunder at identificere mulige kandidater samt gennemføre forhandlinger. Rådgiveren skal i forbindelse med udarbejdelsen af forretningsplanen og ved dialog med potentielle samarbejdspartnere/investorer vurdere sammen med By & Havn, om nogle af erhvervsfelterne skal inkluderes i joint venture-samarbejdet, for derved at skabe en mere attraktiv business case. Udførelsen af aftalen forventes igangsat i umiddelbar forlængelse af kontraktindgåelsen, som er planlagt til at finde sted umiddelbart før juleferien 2026. Aftalen løber som det klare udgangspunkt frem til, at joint venture-aftalen med samarbejdspartneren/investoren er indgået. Ud fra forventningerne til vedtagelse af lokalplan for Levantkaj, vil det for By & Havn være optimalt, hvis kontrakten med samarbejdspartneren/investoren (joint venture-aftalen) er på plads før 1. august 2027 og helst allerede inden industrisommerferien starter. By & Havn anerkender dog, at en række forhold kan føre til, at det ikke vil være muligt at have joint venture-aftalen på plads inden for den ønskede tidsramme. Rådgiver må under alle omstændigheder påregne, at arbejdet med begge hovedopgaver vil være intenst og forudsætte en kompetent og fleksibel projektorganisation. By & Havn har valgt at udbyde én samlet kontrakt i stedet for at opdele kontrakten i delkontrakter, da det er By & Havns vurdering, at det dels er nødvendigt med en samlet forretningsplan for hele Levantkaj, dels at det er klart mest hensigtsmæssigt i forhold til snitflader og i forhold til en hurtig udførelse, at det er den samme rådgiver, der udfører begge hovedopgaver.
